title: 中国古装剧《嫁金钗》热度席卷泰国，登顶Netflix泰国区剧集榜
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 近期，中国古装剧集《嫁金钗》在泰国流媒体市场掀起追剧热潮。根据Netflix平台榜单数据显示，截至2026年10月18日，该剧成功登顶Netflix泰国区剧集排行榜榜首，成为当下泰国观众关注度最高的海外剧集。 Screenshot 据悉，《嫁金钗》于2026年上线，全剧共14集，由田曦薇、闫桉领衔主演。剧集融合古装、爱情、剧情等多重元素，故事以古代为背景，围绕身份错位下的人物羁绊与情感纠葛展开叙事，打造出反转不断的古装爱情故事。 为适配泰国本地观众观看习惯，Netflix上线版本配备泰语配音与泰文字幕，消除语言壁垒，也让更多泰国观众能够无障碍欣赏这部华语作品。 Screenshot Screenshot 剧集登顶榜单后，在泰国社交平台引发大量网友讨论，不少泰国观众分享追剧感受： “一个是为了活下去才作恶，但内心仍然懂得体谅别人、心怀同情。另一个则是真正的恶人，自私自利、心狠手辣，完全不把别人的生命当回事。” “剧情好，题材紧跟时代，节奏紧凑，演员演技也很棒。” “女主演得太好了！剧情精彩，节奏推进很快，一点都不拖沓，看得很过瘾！” “已经看到第8集了，第9集快点更新吧！等不及啦！” 近年来，多部中国古装剧持续登陆Netflix等国际流媒体平台，凭借精致的古装造型、东方传统文化底蕴与细腻的情感叙事，持续吸引泰国乃至东南亚观众。本次《嫁金钗》登顶榜单，再次印证华语影视作品在泰国市场强劲的传播力与受众潜力。 Screenshot Screenshot Screenshot （编辑：Wan；来源：Watch From Home、Netflix） The post 中国古装剧《嫁金钗》热度席卷泰国，登顶Netflix泰国区剧集榜 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: รอบรั้วการตลาด : ธนากร ประธานกรรมการ TAS ขึ้นแท่น บุคคลตัวอย่างภาคธุรกิจแห่งปี 2026
desc: ธนากร ศิริวัฒนาเลิศ ประธานกรรมการ TAS ได้รับคัดเลือก ขึ้นแท่นบุคคลตัวอย่างภาคธุรกิจแห่งปี 2026 จากมูลนิธิสภาวิทยาศาสตร์และเทคโนโลยีแห่งประเทศไทย
title_cn: TAS主席ธนากร获选2026年度泰国商界人物楷模
summary_cn: 泰国科学和技术理事会基金会宣布，TAS主席ธนากร ศิริวัฒนาเลิศ荣获2026年度商界人物楷模称号。该奖项由泰国权威商业和科技机构评选，旨在表彰在商业领域作出卓越贡献、树立行业典范的杰出企业领袖。获得此殊荣充分肯定了ธนากร在推动泰国商业发展和产业创新中所做出的重要贡献。
desc_original: ธนากร ศิริวัฒนาเลิศ ประธานกรรมการ TAS ได้รับคัดเลือก ขึ้นแท่นบุคคลตัวอย่างภาคธุรกิจแห่งปี 2026 จากมูลนิธิสภาวิทยาศาสตร์และเทคโนโลยีแห่งประเทศไทย

title: Phuket eyes AI system to keep tourists safe
desc: Phuket eyes AI system to keep tourists safe Legacy Phuket officials are considering an AI safety system to identify potential threats to tourists , issue early warnings, and help government agencies respond faster to emergencies . The proposal was discussed on Saturday, October 17, but no budget or launch date has been announced. Phuket Governor Chotnarin Kerdsom met researchers from Walailak University to discuss using artificial intelligence and large-scale data analysis to improve tourist safety, with Phuket proposed as a pilot location. According to The Phuket News, the system would build on existing provincial dashboards, bringing together information on tourism, traffic, waste management and public safety. Photo via Phuket PR Department It would also analyse government records, reports from officials on the ground and social media discussions in multiple languages to identify emerging concerns affecting both Thai and international visitors. A proposed risk map would classify threats into four levels: low, medium, high and critical. Officials could then use the information to identify areas requiring attention and respond “before problems escalate”. Photo via Phuke
title_cn: 普吉岛拟引入AI系统强化游客安全防护
summary_cn: 普吉岛官方正与瓦莱拉克大学合作研究AI安全系统，以识别潜在威胁、发出预警并加快应急响应。该系统拟整合旅游、交通、环卫、公共安全等领域数据，分析政府记录和多语言社交媒体讨论，将风险分为低、中、高、严重四个等级。目前仍无确定预算和启动时间，普吉岛被提议作为试点地区，有望在问题扩大前及时介入。

title: 中国籍男子非法入境泰国被捕，曾涉多起电信诈骗案件
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月17日，泰国警方在曼谷RCA地区一家餐厅内抓获一名37岁中国籍男子，其涉嫌非法入境泰国且无法出示护照或其他有效旅行证件。此外，该男子还涉嫌电信及互联网诈骗，中国警方正追查其下落。 此前，泰国移民局警方接到举报，称曼谷RCA一带有外国人疑似非法入境，遂派员前往调查并在当地一家餐厅内发现被举报人员。 经由翻译询问，该男子承认自己没有护照或其他有效旅行证件，通过泰老边境自然通道非法进入泰国。其从老挝乘船渡河抵达泰国，随后联系接应人员并支付约10万泰铢请求协助非法入境，全程未经过移民部门检查及许可。 警方核查移民局信息系统后未发现该男子的入境记录。目前，警方已将其移交移民局调查部门，依法进行进一步处理。 此外，泰国警方收到中国有关安全部门的协查信息，称该男子涉嫌参与电信及互联网诈骗犯罪。泰方正与相关部门核实信息，后续将依法处理。 泰国移民局表示，将继续追查协助外国人非法入境的相关人员及犯罪团伙，防止泰国沦为跨国犯罪人员的藏身之所。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan） The post 中国籍男子非法入境泰国被捕，曾涉多起电信诈骗案件 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Bangkok meetings offer economic boost
desc: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings provided Thailand with an opportunity to showcase its cultural strengths, generate business activity and lay the foundations for longer-term economic gains, according to industry leaders.
title_cn: 曼谷国际会议为经济增长奠基
summary_cn: IMF（国际货币基金组织）与世界银行年度会议在曼谷举办，为泰国提供展现文化优势、发展商业机遇的平台。业界人士认为此次国际会议不仅能带动短期商业活动，更将为泰国长期经济增长奠定坚实基础，有助于提升泰国在国际经济舞台上的影响力。
desc_original: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings provided Thailand with an opportunity to showcase its cultural strengths, generate business activity and lay the foundations for longer-term economic gains, according to industry leaders.

title: Flying solo: the trend of living alone
desc: The growing number of single people in Thailand represents more than just a social change. Living alone is becoming a structural shift that is reshaping the Thai economy and ushering in a new era of consumption.
title_cn: 泰国独居浪潮重塑消费经济
summary_cn: 泰国单身人口不断增长，独居已经演变为一种结构性社会转变，而非简单的人口统计现象。这种趋势正在深刻重塑泰国经济和消费市场，标志着新的消费时代和商业模式的诞生，企业和产业需要适应这一新消费结构。
desc_original: The growing number of single people in Thailand represents more than just a social change. Living alone is becoming a structural shift that is reshaping the Thai economy and ushering in a new era of consumption.

title: AI agents emerge as growth driver
desc: Thailand's IT market is expected to receive a boost from government solar power projects in the fourth quarter, while growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) agents could become a driver of enterprise IT spending next year, offsetting weak consumer purchasing power and rising hardware costs.
title_cn: AI 智能体成为增长引擎
summary_cn: 泰国信息技术市场预计在第四季度因政府太阳能项目获得提振，而人工智能（AI）智能体的采用增加有望成为明年企业 IT 支出的驱动力，抵消消费者购买力疲软和硬件成本上升的影响。
desc_original: Thailand's IT market is expected to receive a boost from government solar power projects in the fourth quarter, while growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) agents could become a driver of enterprise IT spending next year, offsetting weak consumer purchasing power and rising hardware costs.

title: Dept opposes plan to open mine near world heritage site
desc: A conservation agency in Phetchaburi has opposed a proposed dolomite mine near Kaeng Krachan World Heritage Site, warning of potential harm to wildlife, water resources and local communities.
title_cn: 部门反对在世界遗产地附近开矿计划
summary_cn: 碧差汶府（Phetchaburi）保护机构反对在凯考卡炎世界遗产地（Kaeng Krachan World Heritage Site）附近开设白云石矿，警示可能对野生动物、水资源和当地社区造成危害。
desc_original: A conservation agency in Phetchaburi has opposed a proposed dolomite mine near Kaeng Krachan World Heritage Site, warning of potential harm to wildlife, water resources and local communities.

title: Dolphin conservation efforts broaden
desc: On the shores of Songkhla Lake, the survival of endangered Irrawaddy dolphins is tied to the livelihoods of the people who share their habitat.
title_cn: 海豚保护工作范围扩大
summary_cn: 松卡拉湖（Songkhla Lake）沿岸，濒危伊洛瓦底江豚（Irrawaddy dolphins）的生存与当地社群共享栖息地的生计紧密相连，多方保护合作日渐深化。
desc_original: On the shores of Songkhla Lake, the survival of endangered Irrawaddy dolphins is tied to the livelihoods of the people who share their habitat.

title: Ministry eyes extension to B40 promotion train tickets
desc: The Transport Ministry is considering extending the 40-baht all-day fare scheme for Bangkok's Red and Purple electric train lines beyond its Nov 30 expiry.
title_cn: 交通部考虑延长 40 铢地铁优惠票价方案
summary_cn: 曼谷运输部正考虑将红线和紫线电车 40 铢全天优惠票价方案延期至 11 月 30 日后继续实施，以促进公共交通使用并减轻乘客交通成本。
desc_original: The Transport Ministry is considering extending the 40-baht all-day fare scheme for Bangkok's Red and Purple electric train lines beyond its Nov 30 expiry.

title: Prachin Buri oil leak suspected
desc: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is now testing water quality and preparing to contain oil slicks in Prachin Buri after a suspected oil film was detected, amid concerns it could reach the Prachin Buri River.
title_cn: 北碧府（Prachin Buri）疑似石油泄漏
summary_cn: 泰国污染管制部（PCD）检测到疑似油膜后，正在测试水质并准备清理北碧府油迹，担忧污染可能蔓延至北碧河，涉及饮用水安全和环境保护。
desc_original: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is now testing water quality and preparing to contain oil slicks in Prachin Buri after a suspected oil film was detected, amid concerns it could reach the Prachin Buri River.

title: Investment takes centre stage after curtain falls
desc: Thailand's challenge involves turning international exposure into concrete investment projects that support the country's long-term competitiveness after hosting the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings, say executives.
title_cn: 国际曝光转化为实质投资成泰国当前挑战
summary_cn: 泰国刚刚主办IMF-世界银行年会，业界人士指出该国面临的关键挑战是将国际关注度转化为具体投资项目，以支撑长期竞争力。
desc_original: Thailand's challenge involves turning international exposure into concrete investment projects that support the country's long-term competitiveness after hosting the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings, say executives.

title: Restaurants promote  Thai delicacies
desc: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings offered a prominent platform to showcase Thai cuisine, says the president of the Thai Restaurant Association.
title_cn: 餐饮业借IMF-世界银行年会推介泰国美食
summary_cn: 泰国餐饮协会主席表示，IMF-世界银行年会为泰国美食提供了展示平台，有利于推广泰国饮食文化和餐饮业发展。
desc_original: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings offered a prominent platform to showcase Thai cuisine, says the president of the Thai Restaurant Association.

title: Call for wellness reforms as global demand rises
desc: As the government pinpoints medical and wellness services as a new economic growth engine, operators in this sector say several developments are needed for the country to fully benefit from the rising demand.
title_cn: 全球需求上升 业界呼吁推进医疗健康产业改革
summary_cn: 泰国政府将医疗和健康服务列为新的经济增长引擎，但产业从业者指出，该国需要进行多方面改革才能充分利用不断增长的国际需求，抓住产业发展机遇。
desc_original: As the government pinpoints medical and wellness services as a new economic growth engine, operators in this sector say several developments are needed for the country to fully benefit from the rising demand.

title: Monomax hopes to break even next year thanks to subscribers
desc: Jasmine International Plc (JAS) expects Monomax, the streaming platform under Mono Next, to break even next year as subscribers surge to 1.5 million from roughly 900,000.
title_cn: Monomax流媒体平台有望明年扭亏为盈
summary_cn: 茉莉花国际公司（JAS）旗下流媒体平台Monomax预期用户数将从约90万增至150万，基于订户增长势头，该平台有望在明年实现扭亏为盈。
desc_original: Jasmine International Plc (JAS) expects Monomax, the streaming platform under Mono Next, to break even next year as subscribers surge to 1.5 million from roughly 900,000.

title: Traders in Khlong Chan Flats rebuild after historic floods
desc: Small business owners in Khlong Chan Flats have reopened their shops after a week of severe flooding, but mounting debts and lost income are driving calls for urgent government assistance.
title_cn: 隆昌平民小区（Khlong Chan Flats）商户洪灾后重建
summary_cn: 曼谷隆昌平民小区商户在经历一周严重洪灾后已陆续重开店铺，但累积债务和收入损失促使他们呼吁政府提供紧急援助，帮助度过难关。
desc_original: Small business owners in Khlong Chan Flats have reopened their shops after a week of severe flooding, but mounting debts and lost income are driving calls for urgent government assistance.

title: Restaurants confront uncertain outlook
desc: The Thai restaurant industry anticipates an uneven recovery in the fourth quarter this year.
title_cn: 泰国餐饮业前景堪忧
summary_cn: 泰国餐饮行业对今年第四季度的经济复苏前景感到担忧，预期增长将呈现不均衡态势。面对消费者支出波动、劳动力成本上升等多重挑战，行业普遍预期复苏进程将较为缓慢且参差不齐。这种不确定性对从业人员和投资者带来考验。
desc_original: The Thai restaurant industry anticipates an uneven recovery in the fourth quarter this year.

title: TDRI warns of growth concentration in sectors
desc: Thailand's economy is experiencing uneven growth, in which some sectors and groups benefit while others fall behind, meaning ordinary people are not benefiting, says an economist at Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI).
title_cn: 泰国发展研究所警告经济增长集中在少数行业
summary_cn: 泰国发展研究所（TDRI）经济学家指出，泰国当前经济增长呈现不均衡态势，部分行业和社会群体获益明显，但其他群体相对落后，导致普通民众难以从经济增长中受益。这反映了增长红利分配不均的深层问题，需要政策层面的更多关注和调整。
desc_original: Thailand's economy is experiencing uneven growth, in which some sectors and groups benefit while others fall behind, meaning ordinary people are not benefiting, says an economist at Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI).

title: Rail travel to expand in 5 provinces
desc: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to expand rail-based public transport into five regional provinces, aiming to improve connectivity, attract investment and support economic growth beyond Bangkok.
title_cn: 轨道交通拟向5个省份扩展
summary_cn: 泰国大众快速运输局（MRTA）计划向五个地区省份扩展轨道交通网络，旨在改善区域连接、吸引外来投资并促进曼谷外围地区的经济增长。此项目是泰国长期基础设施发展战略的重要一环，将通过便利的交通条件为沿线地区创造更多发展机遇。
desc_original: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to expand rail-based public transport into five regional provinces, aiming to improve connectivity, attract investment and support economic growth beyond Bangkok.

title: Experts urge use of 'alternative data' for better credit checks
desc: As Asean's digital economy accelerates, policymakers and financial leaders are turning to alternative data as a tool to broaden access to credit for businesses and individuals excluded from traditional systems.
title_cn: 专家呼吁运用「替代数据」完善信用评估体系
summary_cn: 随着东盟数字经济加速发展，政策制定者和金融领导者转向利用替代数据技术，以扩大被传统信用系统排斥的企业和个人的信贷获取渠道。这一举措有助于推动金融包容性发展，让更多中小微企业和个人获得融资机会，是适应数字时代的重要金融创新方向。
desc_original: As Asean's digital economy accelerates, policymakers and financial leaders are turning to alternative data as a tool to broaden access to credit for businesses and individuals excluded from traditional systems.

title: Online gambling crackdown  deemed 'ineffective' by ex-MP
desc: Former Democrat Party MP Sirichoke Sopha has questioned the effectiveness of the Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry's crackdown on online gambling, claiming that five major betting websites remain accessible from Thailand despite the ministry's announcement that it had blocked 945,075 links.
title_cn: 前议员批评网络赌博打击行动「效果甚微」
summary_cn: 泰国民主党前议员西里猜·索帕（Sirichoke Sopha）质疑数字经济与社会部打击网络赌博的有效性。官方声称已阻止945,075个链接，但西里猜指出五家主要赌博网站仍可从泰国访问。这反映了网络监管与实际执行效果之间存在的差距，引发对政策有效性的讨论。
desc_original: Former Democrat Party MP Sirichoke Sopha has questioned the effectiveness of the Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry's crackdown on online gambling, claiming that five major betting websites remain accessible from Thailand despite the ministry's announcement that it had blocked 945,075 links.

title: World Bank loans $200m
desc: Thailand has secured US$200 million (6.7 billion baht) in World Bank financing for clean energy and low-carbon cities, turning its International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank annual meetings into economic opportunities for businesses and communities.
title_cn: 世界银行向泰国提供2亿美元清洁能源融资
summary_cn: 泰国在国际货币基金组织与世界银行年会期间，成功获得世界银行2亿美元（约67亿泰铢）融资支持，用于推动清洁能源项目及低碳城市建设。此举为当地企业及社区创造了经济发展机遇，充分把握国际金融机构年会带来的合作机遇。
desc_original: Thailand has secured US$200 million (6.7 billion baht) in World Bank financing for clean energy and low-carbon cities, turning its International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank annual meetings into economic opportunities for businesses and communities.

summary_cn: 随着季节变化，位于泰国北部的披集峰（Phuchee Sky）景区游客明显增多。众多旅客前来欣赏著名的「海雾」奇观，在高海拔群山环抱中感受凉爽山风和独特的自然景观，体验真实的山区气候和生态风貌。

title: Thailand intercepts 7kg heroin in drink sachets bound for Australia
desc: Thailand intercepts 7kg heroin in drink sachets bound for Australia Legacy Thai police have seized around 7 kilogrammes of heroin hidden in drink sachets bound for Australia at a courier facility in Samut Prakan, along with more than 2.5 million yaba pills in a separate operation in Ratchaburi. The heroin seizure followed a tip-off about suspected drug shipments at a private courier facility in Samut Prakan, according to a report today, October 18. Investigators inspected two boxes. Both had sender details in Thailand and were addressed to recipients in Australia. Inside, officers found various brands of instant drink products, but noticed that the sachets felt unusually hard. Photo via เจาะลึกทั่วไทย Inside Thailand When they opened the packets, they discovered white powder wrapped in silver foil. A field test using Marquis reagent turned purple, indicating the presence of heroin. Police seized approximately 7.003 kilogrammes of the drug, classified as a Category 1 narcotic in Thailand, and transferred the evidence to Narcotics Suppression Bureau investigators. title: Suspects killed in Si Sakhon clash linked to earlier cases
desc: Suspects killed in Si Sakhon clash linked to earlier cases Legacy Three suspects were killed in an exchange of gunfire in Narathiwat’s Si Sakhon district yesterday, October 17, in a clash that also left one police officer dead and two paramilitary rangers wounded. Two of the dead had outstanding arrest warrants and have since been linked by DNA records to the earlier Khao Tawe clash, according to Thai-language reports. The shootout began at 11.30am at a house in Si Banphot subdistrict. Both sides opened fire, and Saroj Lodnuan, a patrol squad leader at Si Sakhon Police Station, was killed. Officials identified the dead as 30 year old Haseng Po-ma, 26 year old Abuasnan Chema and 56 year old Yu Kasae, who owned the house. Haseng was wanted over the bombing of a petrol station in Tanyong Mat subdistrict, Rueso district, on January 13. Abuasnan was wanted over the shooting of a married couple, Paisan and Sumon Jungsakul, in Rueso district on June 15, 2019. DNA data in the database links both Haseng and Abuasnan to the clash on Khao Tawe in Cho Airong district on September 9. However, officials are still checking the original forensic results. title: Woman storms Buriram abbot’s quarters in jealous rant
desc: Woman storms Buriram abbot’s quarters in jealous rant Legacy A woman reportedly stormed into an abbot’s quarters at a temple in Buriram and shouted at him in a jealous rant, prompting villagers to call for an investigation. Villagers in Prasat subdistrict, Ban Kruat district, complained on 17 October about the incident, which was recorded in an audio clip. A 42 year old woman, who has not been named, is said to have confronted the abbot inside his residence. The clip reportedly captures the woman venting hurt and jealousy, suggesting the abbot had a new woman in his life. The claims have not been verified. 70 year old Kittiya Jampathong, a villager who visited the temple to make merit, said the woman shouted in the abbot’s quarters for about 30 minutes. She said the woman told him she was not afraid of hell and would go there with him. Kittiya also said she had heard the woman damaged items inside the residence. title: Thick white foam piles up in Pathum Thani canal as fish die
desc: Thick white foam piles up in Pathum Thani canal as fish die Legacy Thick masses of white foam have piled up across a canal in Pathum Thani, where residents are reporting black, foul-smelling water and fish beginning to die. Residents near Wat Lat Sanun in Lam Luk Ka district alerted reporters at around 7am today, October 18, after large amounts of white foam accumulated on the surface of Khlong 1, accompanied by a strong unpleasant smell. Reporters found several pumping stations channelling water directly into Khlong 1 from nearby streets and residential areas, including Bun Khum Road and Phun Phon housing estate in Lam Sam Kaeo municipality. Photo via Amarin TV The continuous flow of water was accompanied by large quantities of white foam spreading across the surface and collecting in thick patches. Residents expressed concern that the foam could contain chemicals or other harmful pollutants, drawing comparisons with previous reports of unexplained foam appearing elsewhere in Pathum Thani. title: Call centre scam gang tells student to fake own kidnapping
desc: Call centre scam gang tells student to fake own kidnapping Legacy Police rescued a university student in Bangkok’s Phaya Thai area yesterday, October 17, after a call centre scam gang convinced them to hide in a rented room and stage a fake kidnapping to extort their parents for up to 300,000 baht (US$9,018). Pathumwan Police Station received a report from the student’s parents that the student had left their accommodation and tried to harm themselves. Officers traced the student to a dormitory in Soi Sasana at about 6pm. The student was still on the phone to the scammers, who hung up when police arrived. The scam began on October 16, when a caller posing as a mobile network employee claimed the student’s ID card had been used to open a phone number linked to fraud and money laundering. The caller correctly recited the student’s 13 digit ID number. The student was then passed to a fake provincial police officer, who ordered them into a Telegram chat room called the interrogation room. Under pressure to prove their innocence, the student transferred 36,000 baht to the gang. The gang told the student to rent a room by the day and switch phone numbers so family could not make contact.
title_cn: 曼谷诈骗集团骗学生「自导自演绑匪」　企图敲诈30万泰铢
summary_cn: 曼谷帕亚泰区一名大学生被电话诈骗集团欺骗，被指控使用虚假身份进行欺诈犯罪。诈骗分子冒充电信员工，准确背诵受害人13位身份证号，后转接假冒省级警察，将其纳入Telegram「审讯室」聊天组。学生在压力下先转账36000泰铢，后被指示租住日租房并更换电话号码，以隔断家庭联系并自导假绑匪案以敲诈父母最多30万泰铢。警方10月17日在索萨纳巷宿舍救出该学生，诈骗分子在警察到达时挂断电话。

title: MRTA to review Hat Yai's monorail

title: Ministry eyes illegal dumping

title: Pension reform needs good governance
desc: Pension reforms should protect retirement savings while allowing funds to invest in domestic economies, with sound governance and returns for members remaining the top priorities, forum speakers said.

summary_cn: 论坛发言人表示，养老金改革应在保护退休储蓄的同时允许基金投资国内经济，健全的治理和成员回报应成为首要优先事项。
desc_original: Pension reforms should protect retirement savings while allowing funds to invest in domestic economies, with sound governance and returns for members remaining the top priorities, forum speakers said.

title: Police trace 'cannabis' sweets

desc_original: Police are tracing the source of online-purchased sweets suspected of containing cannabis after three family members, including a two-year-old boy, became seriously ill.

desc_original: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is investigating pollution in Rangsit canal in Pathum Thani after mass fish deaths and reports of dark, foul-smelling water.

title: Flood warning as heavy rain set to hit all week
desc: Heavy to very heavy rain is forecast across Thailand from today until Sunday, bringing flood and landslide risks, while a strengthening El Nino could delay the cold season and keep temperatures above normal, the Meteorological Department warned.

title: Govt fleshes out energy transition plans
desc: Thailand plans to accelerate its green transition by reducing energy import dependence, attracting private investment and strengthening climate resilience while creating jobs.
title_cn: 泰国加快能源转型，力争减少进口依赖
summary_cn: 泰国政府推进绿色能源转型计划，目标减少能源进口依赖，加强国家能源自主性。计划通过吸引私人投资、提升气候韧性，同时促进绿色产业发展，创造新的就业机会，助力经济可持续增长。
desc_original: Thailand plans to accelerate its green transition by reducing energy import dependence, attracting private investment and strengthening climate resilience while creating jobs.

title: Swiss forge new links ahead of free trade pact
desc: Thailand and Switzerland are seeking to expand trade and investment ties ahead of a free trade deal targeted to take effect on Jan 1, 2027, Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.
title_cn: 泰瑞自由贸易协议在即，加强双边经贸合作
summary_cn: 泰国与瑞士为即将生效的自由贸易协议做准备，双方正加强贸易和投资合作。根据泰国商业部长素帕吉公布的计划，两国自由贸易协议目标于2027年1月1日生效，届时有望扩大双边经贸往来。
desc_original: Thailand and Switzerland are seeking to expand trade and investment ties ahead of a free trade deal targeted to take effect on Jan 1, 2027, Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.

title: Thailand weather today, 18 October: heavy rain in 14 provinces, Bangkok showers
desc: Thailand weather today, 18 October: heavy rain in 14 provinces, Bangkok showers Legacy The Thai Meteorological Department forecasts heavy rain in 14 provinces today, 18 October 2026. Bangkok can expect scattered showers, with lows and highs of 24-35°C. The weak high-pressure system from China covers the upper North, the upper Northeast of Thailand and the South China Sea leading to the easterly wind prevails over Thailand and the Gulf while the monsoon trough lies across the lower South. Isolated heavy rains are forecat in the East and the South while isolated thundershowers are still possible in the upper country. Bangkok Scattered thundershowers. Minimum temperature 24-26°C. Maximum temperature 33-35°C. Easterly wind 10-20 km/h. North Isolated thundershowers mostly in Mae Hong Son, Tak, and Kamphaeng Phet. Minimum temperature 21-26°C. Maximum temperature 33-36°C. Easterly wind 10-20 km/h. Northeast Isolated thundershowers mostly in Nakhon Ratchasima, Buriram, Surin, Sisaket, and Ubon Ratchathani. Minimum temperature 21-24°C. Maximum temperature 33-35°C. Northeasterly wind 10-20 km/h. Central Scattered thundershowers mostly in Saraburi, Suphan Buri, Kanchanaburi, Ratchaburi, Nakho

title: Competing ‘Nene Royal’ trademark bids emerge
desc: Confusion has arisen over trademark applications for the stage name of Thai teen rocker Nene Royal, after a woman whose connection to the America’s Got Talent winner is unclear filed to register the name and logo — even before the artist’s managing company.

title: Haze triggers highest-level alert in parts of Southeast Asia
desc: SINGAPORE - Fires in Indonesia that have sent toxic smoke disrupting daily life across Southeast Asia has triggered the highest-level alert by the regional bloc’s meteorological monitor.

title: IMF chief sees ‘optimism and worry’ at Bangkok talks
desc: International Monetary Fund chief Kristalina Georgieva said on Saturday that this year’s annual meetings with global policymakers were marked by “optimism and worry” about the global economic outlook as the event wound down in Bangkok.
title_cn: IMF 总裁在曼谷论坛表示感受到「乐观与担忧」
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织总裁格奥尔基耶娃在曼谷表示，今年全球政策制定者年度会议充满了对全球经济前景的「乐观与担忧」。会议已圆满结束，反映出当前全球经济形势的复杂性与不确定性并存的态势。

desc: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha is demanding a deeper investigation into the blocking of the crypto gambling website Shuffle.com and the role played in the business by the husband of Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap.

title: We must save the poor, just not see them or hear them
desc: Fully acknowledging that international financial bodies do not have direct influence over the decisions of countries like, say, Thailand, it is still difficult to deny the disconnect as conference delegates gravely discuss “safety nets” for the vulnerable while police keep those very people physically at bay.
title_cn: 国际会议的虚伪：讨论救济贫困同时将穷人赶出视线
summary_cn: 评论指出，国际金融会议期间，与会者一面讨论向弱势群体提供「安全网」，一面却由警察将穷人驱离现场。这在泰国等国体现为社会政策的虚伪性——表面承诺扶贫，实际对贫困人群视而不见，形成令人不安的反差。
desc_original: Fully acknowledging that international financial bodies do not have direct influence over the decisions of countries like, say, Thailand, it is still difficult to deny the disconnect as conference delegates gravely discuss “safety nets” for the vulnerable while police keep those very people physically at bay.

title: 泰总理阿努廷会见OECD秘书长，重申泰国加入组织的坚定决心
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月17日，据泰媒报道，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷通过个人脸书账号发布消息，介绍其在2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行年会期间，与经济合作与发展组织（OECD）秘书长马蒂亚斯·科曼会面的情况，并再次强调泰国政府加入组织的坚定决心。 阿努廷表示，此次与OECD秘书长会面，是泰国进一步深化与该组织合作的重要机会。他重申，泰国将继续积极推进加入OECD的相关工作，并与该组织保持密切合作，同时对科曼长期以来给予泰国的支持表示感谢。 阿努廷指出，加入OECD不仅意味着泰国能够进一步加强与国际社会的联系，更是推动国内改革、增强经济实力的重要契机。通过借鉴国际经验、完善相关制度及推进经济改革，泰国有望进一步提升国家竞争力，为未来经济发展创造更加稳固的基础。他强调，泰国政府希望通过加入该组织，推动经济结构转型和持续增长，进而提高民众收入水平，改善人民生活质量，使国家发展成果更好地惠及社会各界。 阿努廷表示，积极争取成为OECD成员，是泰国迈向新经济时代的重要战略方向之一。政府将继续以坚定的信心推进相关工作，通过深化国际合作与国内改革，为泰国人民创造更多发展机会，推动国家实现长期进步。 OECD是致力于促进经济发展、改善公共政策及提升社会福祉的国际组织，其成员主要包括欧洲、北美及亚太地区的发达经济体，同时也涵盖部分新兴经济体。泰国目前正推进加入该组织的相关程序，希望通过深化合作，推动国内政策及制度与国际标准进一步接轨。 此次会面也反映出泰国政府希望借助2026年IMF-世界银行年会这一国际平台，进一步扩大对外经济合作，并将国际社会的支持转化为推动国内改革和经济发展的动力。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：thairath） The post 泰总理阿努廷会见OECD秘书长，重申泰国加入组织的坚定决心 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰总理阿努廷与 OECD 秘书长会晤，重申加入组织的战略决心
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷在 IMF 年会期间与经济合作与发展组织（OECD）秘书长马蒂亚斯·科曼（Mathias Cormann）会面。阿努廷强调加入 OECD 对泰国战略意义重大，将有助于完善政策制度、增强经济竞争力、推动经济结构转型，最终提高国民生活水平。政府将其列为进入新经济时代的重要战略方向。

title: 突发！陶公府枪战造成2死2伤，泰南三府接连发生暴力事件
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月17日上午，泰国安全部队在陶公府执行地区管控任务期间，与一伙武装人员发生激烈交火，造成1名警察死亡、2名准军事部队人员受伤，另有1名涉事武装人员被击毙。由于当地近期接连发生枪击及爆炸袭击事件，安全部门已进一步加强警戒，并呼吁民众远离事发地区。 据泰国安全部门通报，当天上午11时30分左右，警方及相关安全部队组成联合行动小组，进入陶公府执行地区管控任务。行动过程中，执法人员突然与当地一伙武装人员相遇，双方随即发生枪战，安全部队立即展开还击。 此次交火造成一名警察不幸殉职，死者为51岁的警长萨罗。此外，两名准军事部队志愿人员在交火中受伤，分别为34岁的披切（头部及背部受伤）和35岁的吉迪萨（左侧腰部及背部受伤）。安全部门同时确认，参与交火的武装人员中有1人被击毙。 事发后，安全部队迅速增派人员控制现场，并组织救援力量将受伤人员送往医院接受治疗。执法人员继续对事发区域实施警戒及管控，防止发生进一步冲突。目前，相关部门仍在调查涉事武装人员的身份、所属组织及此次交火的具体经过。安全部门已向当地居民发出提醒，要求民众暂时避免前往陶公府发生交火的区域，尤其不要擅自进入军警正在执行任务的地点，以免遭遇流弹或其他危险。 值得注意的是，此次枪战并非泰国南部边境地区近期发生的唯一暴力事件。就在前一天，即10月16日13时30分左右，北大年府发生一起针对地方防卫志愿人员的枪击事件。一名地方防卫志愿队成员骑摩托车前往参加伊斯兰礼拜途中，遭身份不明的武装人员伏击，当场死亡，另有一名男子受伤。伤者随后被送往医院，但最终因伤势严重不治身亡，使该起袭击事件的死亡人数增至2人。警方在现场发现一辆绿色雅马哈摩托车、一把手枪、6枚9毫米弹壳及1枚弹头，目前仍在调查事件经过及涉事人员身份。 而在10月15日18时45分左右，惹拉府一处地方防卫队驻地同样遭到爆炸袭击。身份不明人员向驻地人员住宿区域投掷两枚爆炸装置，其中一枚发生爆炸，造成5名驻地人员不同程度受伤，包括腿部受伤、耳部出血、耳鸣及头痛等症状。伤者随后被送往医院接受治疗。安全部门初步怀疑，袭击与当地活动的武装团体有关，目前已联合警方、军方及爆炸物处理人员展开调查。 短短3天内，泰国南部陶公府、北大年府及惹拉府接连发生枪战、伏击及爆炸袭击事件，造成多名安全人员伤亡，反映出当地安全局势仍然紧张。泰国安全部门已加强对相关地区的警戒和巡查，并持续追查涉事人员及武装组织。 对于近期计划前往泰国南部地区的民众及游客，建议密切关注当地安全部门发布的最新通报，尤其应谨慎前往陶公府、北大年府及惹拉府近期发生袭击的地区，避免靠近军事设施、警察检查站及正在执行安全行动的区域。若遇到临时封路、军事管制或安全警戒，应立即配合现场执法人员指示，确保自身安全。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：nationtv） The p
title_cn: 泰南三府三日内连发暴力事件，陶公府枪战警官殉职
summary_cn: 泰国南部边境地区三天内连续发生多起暴力事件：10 月 17 日陶公府（Trang）枪战造成 1 名警长殉职、2 名准军事人员受伤；16 日北大年府（Pattani）伏击致 2 人死亡；15 日惹拉府（Yala）驻地遭爆炸袭击，5 人受伤。事件反映泰南安全局势紧张，安全部队已加强警戒。建议游客避开相关地区。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月17日上午，泰国安全部队在陶公府执行地区管控任务期间，与一伙武装人员发生激烈交火，造成1名警察死亡、2名准军事部队人员受伤，另有1名涉事武装人员被击毙。由于当地近期接连发生枪击及爆炸袭击事件，安全部门已进一步加强警戒，并呼吁民众远离事发地区。 据泰国安全部门通报，当天上午11时30分左右，警方及相关安全部队组成联合行动小组，进入陶公府执行地区管控任务。行动过程中，执法人员突然与当地一伙武装人员相遇，双方随即发生枪战，安全部队立即展开还击。 此次交火造成一名警察不幸殉职，死者为51岁的警长萨罗。此外，两名准军事部队志愿人员在交火中受伤，分别为34岁的披切（头部及背部受伤）和35岁的吉迪萨（左侧腰部及背部受伤）。安全部门同时确认，参与交火的武装人员中有1人被击毙。 事发后，安全部队迅速增派人员控制现场，并组织救援力量将受伤人员送往医院接受治疗。执法人员继续对事发区域实施警戒及管控，防止发生进一步冲突。目前，相关部门仍在调查涉事武装人员的身份、所属组织及此次交火的具体经过。安全部门已向当地居民发出提醒，要求民众暂时避免前往陶公府发生交火的区域，尤其不要擅自进入军警正在执行任务的地点，以免遭遇流弹或其他危险。 值得注意的是，此次枪战并非泰国南部边境地区近期发生的唯一暴力事件。就在前一天，即10月16日13时30分左右，北大年府发生一起针对地方防卫志愿人员的枪击事件。一名地方防卫志愿队成员骑摩托车前往参加伊斯兰礼拜途中，遭身份不明的武装人员伏击，当场死亡，另有一名男子受伤。伤者随后被送往医院，但最终因伤势严重不治身亡，使该起袭击事件的死亡人数增至2人。警方在现场发现一辆绿色雅马哈摩托车、一把手枪、6枚9毫米弹壳及1枚弹头，目前仍在调查事件经过及涉事人员身份。 而在10月15日18时45分左右，惹拉府一处地方防卫队驻地同样遭到爆炸袭击。身份不明人员向驻地人员住宿区域投掷两枚爆炸装置，其中一枚发生爆炸，造成5名驻地人员不同程度受伤，包括腿部受伤、耳部出血、耳鸣及头痛等症状。伤者随后被送往医院接受治疗。安全部门初步怀疑，袭击与当地活动的武装团体有关，目前已联合警方、军方及爆炸物处理人员展开调查。 短短3天内，泰国南部陶公府、北大年府及惹拉府接连发生枪战、伏击及爆炸袭击事件，造成多名安全人员伤亡，反映出当地安全局势仍然紧张。泰国安全部门已加强对相关地区的警戒和巡查，并持续追查涉事人员及武装组织。 对于近期计划前往泰国南部地区的民众及游客，建议密切关注当地安全部门发布的最新通报，尤其应谨慎前往陶公府、北大年府及惹拉府近期发生袭击的地区，避免靠近军事设施、警察检查站及正在执行安全行动的区域。若遇到临时封路、军事管制或安全警戒，应立即配合现场执法人员指示，确保自身安全。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：nationtv） The p

title: 泰航终于公布赔偿方案：9月底受影响旅客可通过官网申请
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月17日，据泰媒报道，泰国国际航空公司宣布，董事会已正式批准针对9月底暴雨及洪灾期间受影响旅客的赔偿措施。凡因9月26日至30日期间的恶劣天气及洪水情况，遭遇航班延误、航班取消或托运行李延迟交付的乘客，均可通过泰航官方网站提交赔偿申请。对于此前因曼谷素万那普机场行李大规模滞留而受到影响的旅客，泰航也将根据实际情况及相关法律规定，逐案评估赔偿事宜。 泰航在声明中表示，公司充分理解此次事件给乘客造成的困难与不便，并对此深表歉意。为体现企业责任、减轻旅客损失，董事会已批准实施专项赔偿措施，为符合条件的受影响乘客提供相应救济。此次赔偿措施主要涵盖三类旅客：一是因天气及洪灾影响遭遇航班延误的乘客；二是航班被取消的乘客；三是托运行李未能按时送达的乘客。 泰航强调，赔偿并非统一按照固定金额发放，而是将根据每位旅客的实际遭遇、所产生的损失及相关证明材料，结合适用的法律法规和航空运输规定进行个案审核。因此，不同乘客最终能够获得的赔偿金额及处理结果可能有所不同。目前，泰航尚未公布统一赔偿标准、具体赔偿金额或明确的审核完成期限。 受影响旅客可通过以下步骤在线提交申请： 1、进入泰航官方网站，在网站顶部菜单中选择“Contact Us”（联系我们）； 2、点击“Flight Disruption”（航班异常）栏目，进入相关服务申请页面； 3、进入“Request Flight Disruption”（航班异常申请）页面后，根据自身情况选择相应服务： • 如希望就航班延误、取消或相关损失申请赔偿，选择“Compensation”（赔偿申请）； • 如需申请机票或其他费用退款，选择“Refund for Airfare and Other Fees”（机票及其他费用退款）； • 如需向保险公司申请理赔，选择“Flight Certificate”（航班证明），申请相关航班证明文件。 4、按照页面提示填写完整资料，包括个人信息、机票预订信息、航班信息及相关情况说明，并根据实际申请类型提供必要的证明材料； 5、仔细核对填写内容，确认资料准确无误后，点击“Submit”（提交）按钮完成申请。 泰航特别提醒，乘客应提前准备好机票预订资料及航班相关信息，以便顺利填写申请表格，避免因资料缺失或信息错误影响审核进度。对于已提交赔偿申请的旅客，泰航表示，公司将尽快开展审核，并在完成相关评估后主动联系申请人，通知具体处理结果。 对于此前因行李滞留而受到影响的旅客，泰航此次已将“行李延迟交付”明确列入赔偿措施的适用范围。不过，官方发布的线上操作指南主要展示了航班异常相关申请入口，并未单独列出行李延误赔偿的具体操作步骤。因此，涉及行李延迟交付的乘客，可通过泰航官方客服或网站联系渠道进一步确认所需申请材料及提交方式。 泰航表示，将持续推进此次暴雨及洪灾造成的旅客损失处理工作，并按照相关法
title_cn: 泰国航空公开洪灾赔偿方案，9 月受损旅客可在线申请
summary_cn: 泰国国际航空公司公布 9 月 26-30 日暴雨洪灾赔偿方案。受影响旅客（航班延误、取消或行李延迟交付者）可在官方网站依次选择「Contact Us」—「Flight Disruption」—「Compensation」菜单，填写个人及航班信息后在线提交，赔偿金额根据个案评估。

title: 算命先生说她有财运！泰国女工买两张彩票，真的中了1200万
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，泰国红统府一名48岁女工颂斋，在10月16日的泰国政府彩票开奖中，凭借两张相同号码的彩票幸运中得头奖，一举获得1200万泰铢奖金，令她惊喜不已。 颂斋原本在一家工厂工作，是名普通女工。她透露，此前偶然遇到弟弟的一位朋友，对方会算命，她便顺口询问自己最近是否有发财的机会。没想到对方告诉她近期有财运，还建议她买2至7张政府彩票碰碰运气。听完这番话，颂斋决定试试手气，不过上一期购买彩票并没有中奖。 到了10月16日这一期开奖前，颂斋决定再试一次。她原本打算购买与自己出生年份有关的号码，但始终找不到心仪的号码，于是临时改变主意，选择了尾数为“81”的彩票，在平台购买了两张。 当天下午开奖结果公布后，颂斋想起自己购买的彩票尾数是“81”，便向工厂同事提起此事，随后拿出彩票核对中奖号码。没想到，手中的两张彩票竟然与当期头奖号码“011781”完全一致！这意味着她同时中得两注一等奖，每注奖金600万泰铢，合计获得1200万泰铢，瞬间从普通工厂女工变成千万富翁。 面对这笔突如其来的巨额奖金，颂斋难掩激动。她表示，自己已经想好了奖金的用途：首先要为父母建造一栋新房，让他们能够拥有更加舒适的居住环境；剩余的奖金则会存起来，作为孩子未来的教育基金，希望能够为家人提供更好的生活保障。 不过，尽管一夜之间成为千万富翁，颂斋并没有打算因此辞职。她表示，自己仍会继续留在工厂工作，维持原本的生活节奏。对她而言，这笔意外之财不仅意味着经济条件的改善，更让她有机会实现为父母建房、为孩子储备教育资金的心愿。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：thaipost） The post 算命先生说她有财运！泰国女工买两张彩票，真的中了1200万 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 算命先生说她有财运！泰国女工买两张彩票，真的中了1200万
summary_cn: 红统府48岁女工颂斋听从算命师建议购买政府彩票。10月16日开奖，她购买的两张尾数为「81」的彩票与头奖号码「011781」完全一致，中得两注一等奖，共获1200万泰铢。她表示将用奖金为父母建房、储备子女教育基金，同时保留工厂工作。

title: Chinese fugitive behind mule account network arrested in Bangkok
desc: Chinese fugitive behind mule account network arrested in Bangkok Legacy Immigration police have arrested a Chinese fugitive in Bangkok who allegedly ran a mule account network that supplied more than 133 bank accounts to money laundering gangs, with about 500 million yuan (roughly 2 billion baht, or about US$62 million) passing through them. Officers from Immigration Division 3 arrested the 37 year old man, identified as Wu, on Friday, October 16 at a home in a housing estate in Saphan Sung district. China has issued an arrest warrant for him over offences linked to a loan-shark gang. Police said he had evaded immigration officers for more than 3 years. Police said Wu supported a transnational crime gang by paying people to open bank accounts, then collecting the cards and account details and passing them to money laundering groups. He also allegedly exchanged cryptocurrency and foreign currency for criminal groups and arranged visas for members of gangs linked to other laundering cases. Investigators said Wu tried to throw them off by using fake documents to report his address, changing his licence plates and wrapping his car in a different colour. Police used Interpol’s database
title_cn: 中国逃犯曼谷被捕：涉20亿泰铢马甲账户洗钱案
summary_cn: 泰国移民警察于10月16日在曼谷沙潘颂区逮捕37岁中国逃犯吴某。该男子因涉嫌组织马甲账户网络，向洗钱团伙供应130多个银行账户，累计转账约20亿泰铢（约6200万美元），中国对其发出通缉令。警方表示他已躲避移民检查超3年，还涉及收购账户、兑换虚拟货币、安排签证等洗钱相关活动。

Officers from Immigration Division 3 arrested the 37 year old man, identified as Wu, on Friday, October 16 at a home in a housing estate in Saphan Sung district. China has issued an arrest warrant for him over offences linked to a loan-shark gang. Police said he had evaded immigration officers for more than 3 years. Police said Wu supported a transnational crime gang by paying people to open bank accounts, then collecting the cards and account details and passing them to money laundering groups. He also allegedly exchanged cryptocurrency and foreign currency for criminal groups and arranged visas for members of gangs linked to other laundering cases. desc: Sisaket temples handed lottery-style tickets worth 10 million baht Legacy Villagers and a senior monk in Sisaket have criticised a Buddhist college’s charity lottery, saying it looks like illegal gambling and pressures small temples to pay for tickets. title: 罗勇4家KTV被查：专做中国客生意，2家涉卖淫、全部无证经营
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月17日，据泰媒报道，泰国内政部副部长蓬皮亲自率领地方行政厅中央执法人员及罗勇府行政部门前往罗勇府Pluak Daeng县，展开代号为“秘密房间”的专项执法行动，突击检查当地4家KTV娱乐场所。 初步调查发现，这些场所主要面向中国顾客提供包厢式卡拉OK及陪侍服务，其中2家涉嫌存在隐蔽卖淫活动，部分场所还涉及越南籍女性提供陪侍服务。此外，执法部门初步核查发现，4家KTV均未取得泰国《娱乐场所法》规定的经营许可证。 此次行动共涉及4家KTV。根据执法部门此前掌握的线索，部分娱乐场所以私人卡拉OK包厢为主要经营模式，安排女性工作人员陪同顾客消费，同时提供酒精饮料，并收取较高的服务费用，其主要目标客群为中国籍顾客。调查人员表示，经过前期秘密调查，执法部门掌握了其中2家娱乐场所涉嫌以卡拉OK经营为掩护、从事隐蔽卖淫活动的相关证据，同时发现部分越南籍女性在相关场所提供服务，因此决定展开突击检查，进一步核实相关经营活动是否涉及违法行为。 除涉嫌存在卖淫活动外，4家KTV的经营资质也成为此次检查的重点。根据执法人员对许可证资料的初步核查结果，4家场所均未取得泰国《娱乐场所法》规定的娱乐场所经营许可证。不过，执法部门强调，相关经营行为是否构成违法，以及具体涉及哪些罪名，仍须依据调查事实、所掌握的证据及相关法律构成要件进行认定。 泰国内政部地方行政厅表示，此次行动不会仅停留在对娱乐场所的现场检查，而将进一步扩大调查范围，追查相关场所的实际经营者、人员招募及安排者、现场管理人员、幕后投资者，以及真正从经营活动中获取利益的相关人员。对于调查中发现的涉嫌违法行为，执法部门将依据证据依法追究相关责任人的法律责任；涉及被捕人员及查扣物品的，将移交警方调查人员按照法律程序进一步处理。 地方行政厅强调，将持续加强对娱乐场所违法经营活动的监管和打击力度，对涉及违法行为的各级相关人员展开调查，防止有人利用娱乐场所作为掩护，从事卖淫或其他违法活动，并通过相关经营活动非法牟利。 目前，相关案件仍处于调查阶段。执法部门尚未公布具体被捕人数、涉案人员身份及查扣物品的详细情况，4家KTV的具体违法责任仍有待进一步调查确认。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：matichon） The post 罗勇4家KTV被查：专做中国客生意，2家涉卖淫、全部无证经营 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc: The recent floods have renewed questions about Bangkok's long-term flood defences, particularly the omission of previously proposed monkey cheek retention areas from the draft comprehensive city plan due to take effect next year.

summary_cn: 近期曼谷洪水灾害引发人们对城市长期防洪防御的重新评估。问题焦点在于先前提议的蓄洪区遗憾地被排除在即将于明年生效的综合城市规划之外。这一决定令专家和市民担忧城市防灾能力的充分性，并对房产值和城市发展产生潜在影响。
desc_original: The recent floods have renewed questions about Bangkok's long-term flood defences, particularly the omission of previously proposed monkey cheek retention areas from the draft comprehensive city plan due to take effect next year.

title: Thai corporate credit weakens in 2026
desc: Thai corporate credit quality remained under pressure during the first nine months of 2026, with downgrades outnumbering upgrades amid weak operating performances and concerns over liquidity and debt refinancing, says Tris Rating.
title_cn: 泰国企业信用质量在2026年承压
summary_cn: 根据泰国评级机构Tris Rating报告，今年前九个月泰国企业信用质量持续受压，企业降级数量多于升级。主要原因包括经营表现疲弱、流动性短缺和债务再融资风险上升。这反映泰国经济面临结构性挑战，对投资者和经营者有重要参考意义。
desc_original: Thai corporate credit quality remained under pressure during the first nine months of 2026, with downgrades outnumbering upgrades amid weak operating performances and concerns over liquidity and debt refinancing, says Tris Rating.

title: AI demand drives Thai electronics earnings in Q3
desc: Thailand's electronics sector is expected to deliver strong earnings in the third quarter as artificial intelligence (AI) investments lift component demand, improve capacity utilisation and support pricing, although weak non-AI demand and stretched share valuations warrant caution, analysts say.
title_cn: AI需求推动泰国电子产业第三季度增长
summary_cn: 人工智能投资热潮推动泰国电子产业在第三季度取得强劲业绩。AI芯片和组件需求激增，带动产能利用率上升并改善产品定价。不过分析师提醒存在隐忧——非AI领域需求不足，且相关企业股价估值已处高位，投资者需谨慎评估。
desc_original: Thailand's electronics sector is expected to deliver strong earnings in the third quarter as artificial intelligence (AI) investments lift component demand, improve capacity utilisation and support pricing, although weak non-AI demand and stretched share valuations warrant caution, analysts say.

title: Anutin calls for global cooperation
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul called on countries to work together to tackle rapid global change as he formally opened the plenary session of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings.
title_cn: 总理呼吁全球携手应对急速变化
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·詹瓦拉库尔在出席国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行联合年会时正式启幕，呼吁各国加强合作应对当今世界面临的快速变化与挑战。讲话强调了国际协调与多边合作在应对全球问题中的关键作用。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul called on countries to work together to tackle rapid global change as he formally opened the plenary session of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings.

title: Egat prepares for virtual power plant scheme
desc: Thailand is moving towards a more flexible and digitally managed electricity system following the successful testing of a virtual power plant (VPP) project by the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat), according to an official involved in the initiative.
title_cn: 泰国发电局 EGAT 推进虚拟电厂计划
summary_cn: 泰国正朝着更灵活、数字化管理的电力系统方向发展。泰国发电局（EGAT）成功完成虚拟电厂（VPP）项目的实地测试，标志着国家电力供应体系正在经历深刻转变。虚拟电厂系统通过整合分布式电源和需求侧资源，可大幅提升电网运营的效率与灵活性。该项目的成功验证为技术在全国范围内的推广应用奠定了坚实基础。
desc_original: Thailand is moving towards a more flexible and digitally managed electricity system following the successful testing of a virtual power plant (VPP) project by the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat), according to an official involved in the initiative.

title: Hospitals brace for heavy rain
desc: The Public Health Ministry has assigned deputy permanent secretary Dr Sakda Alapach to lead a forward operations centre for heavy rain in 37 districts of seven southern provinces.
title_cn: 泰国南部暴雨来袭 医疗机构严阵以待
summary_cn: 为应对泰国南部即将到来的暴雨灾情，卫生部指派副常任秘书萨尔达医生（Dr Sakda Alapach）领导前线应急指挥中心。该指挥中心负责协调泰国南部7个省份的37个县的防灾与医疗应对工作。此举措旨在确保医疗系统在恶劣天气条件下仍能保持最佳运作能力，及时应对因暴雨引发的伤患和各类急救需求。
desc_original: The Public Health Ministry has assigned deputy permanent secretary Dr Sakda Alapach to lead a forward operations centre for heavy rain in 37 districts of seven southern provinces.

title: Minister apologises over e-harvester price blunder
desc: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has apologised for mistakenly quoting 16 million baht per electric harvester, insisting the ministry has no plans to buy the machines.
title_cn: 农业部长为收割机报价失误道歉
summary_cn: 泰国农业与合作社部长素里亚为就电动收割机价格的言论失误向公众致歉。部长在早前讲话中误述每台电动收割机的价格高达1600万泰铢，此言论一出立即引发舆论广泛关注。部长随后澄清，农业部目前没有购买此类电动收割机的计划，强调刚才的数字报价属于口误，对造成的混淆和误会表示歉意。
desc_original: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has apologised for mistakenly quoting 16 million baht per electric harvester, insisting the ministry has no plans to buy the machines.

title: Academic asks why the BMA overlooked projects
desc: A Kasetsart University academic has questioned why Bangkok allocated more than 34 billion baht to flood prevention over two years while omitting six major eastern water-retention projects from its action plans.
title_cn: 学者质疑曼谷市政遗漏防洪蓄水项目
summary_cn: 农业大学（Kasetsart University）学者对曼谷市政府（Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, BMA）的防洪策略提出质疑。曼谷在两年内投入逾340亿泰铢用于防洪，但却在行动计划中遗漏了东部地区的6个重要蓄水项目。这些被遗漏的项目对防洪和水资源管理至关重要，学者的质疑凸显了市政部门在大型防灾工程规划中的不周之处。
desc_original: A Kasetsart University academic has questioned why Bangkok allocated more than 34 billion baht to flood prevention over two years while omitting six major eastern water-retention projects from its action plans.

title: Households in NE economically vulnerable: poll
desc: The household economy in the northeastern region was "vulnerable" during the third quarter, with no expectations of improvement for the rest of the year, a recent poll found.
title_cn: 东北地区家庭经济脆弱：民调显示
summary_cn: 民调显示，泰国东北地区（Northeast）在第三季度的家庭经济状况「脆弱」，预计全年都不会改善。这一数据反映出该地区作为农业主导地带，经济韧性较弱，易受全球经济波动和本地政策变化影响。
desc_original: The household economy in the northeastern region was "vulnerable" during the third quarter, with no expectations of improvement for the rest of the year, a recent poll found.

title: OECD push requires law reform, say experts
desc: Thailand needs to upgrade its legal and judicial systems ahead of joining the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), academics say.
title_cn: 加入 OECD 需进行法律改革，专家称
summary_cn: 泰国若要加入经济合作与发展组织（OECD），必须升级其法律和司法体系。专家指出这一改革涉及广泛的制度完善，包括行政法规、司法程序及国际条约合规等内容，对泰国长期商业环境和国际地位将产生深远影响。
desc_original: Thailand needs to upgrade its legal and judicial systems ahead of joining the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), academics say.

title: Govt urged to rethink tax allocations
desc: Movendi International has urged Thailand to abandon plans to scrap its earmarked tax system, warning that the move could expose public health policies to political interference and pressure from the alcohol and tobacco industries.
title_cn: 政府被敦促重新审视税收分配方案
summary_cn: 国际公共卫生组织 Movendi International 敦促泰国政府放弃取消专项税制计划，警告此举可能导致公共卫生政策暴露于政治干预和酒类、烟草行业的商业压力。专项税制通常用于支持公共健康项目，是财政独立性的重要保障。
desc_original: Movendi International has urged Thailand to abandon plans to scrap its earmarked tax system, warning that the move could expose public health policies to political interference and pressure from the alcohol and tobacco industries.

title: NBTC defends board meetings
desc: Trairat Viriyasirikul, acting secretary-general of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC), has defended the regulator's decision to proceed with board meetings on Oct 1 and 2, saying the NBTC Office was carrying out its administrative duties based on the instructions of the chairman.
title_cn: 泰国广电委员会为董事会会议辩护
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）代理秘书长为 10 月 1 至 2 日召开的董事会会议进行说明，称该机构按照主席指示履行常规行政职能。此举回应了外界对会议合规性的相关质疑。
desc_original: Trairat Viriyasirikul, acting secretary-general of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC), has defended the regulator's decision to proceed with board meetings on Oct 1 and 2, saying the NBTC Office was carrying out its administrative duties based on the instructions of the chairman.

title: Equity outlook weak as cost of money climbs
desc: The Thai stock market was flat following a sideways-down trend during the previous three weeks.
title_cn: 融资成本攀升 股票市场前景走弱
summary_cn: 泰国股市在过去三周横向下跌后保持平稳，受融资成本上升影响市场情绪偏弱。投资者对后市缺乏信心，反映出泰国资本市场同时受全球利率环境紧缩和本地流动性收紧的双重压制。
desc_original: The Thai stock market was flat following a sideways-down trend during the previous three weeks.

title: Thailand weather today, 17 October: heavy rain in 20 provinces, Bangkok showers
desc: Thailand weather today, 17 October: heavy rain in 20 provinces, Bangkok showers Legacy Heavy rain is forecast in 20 provinces today, with the Central region, the East and the South hit hardest, the Thai Meteorological Department says. Bangkok can expect scattered thundershowers with gust wind, with temperatures of 26-35°C. A weak high-pressure system from China covers the upper North, the upper Northeast and the South China Sea. Easterly and southeasterly winds are carrying moisture from the South China Sea into Thailand and the Gulf. This is triggering thundershowers and isolated heavy rain in the Central region, the East and the South. From 18 to 20 October, continuous rain with isolated heavy to very heavy rain is expected over the South and the East. Rainfall will then increase from 21 to 25 October. Isolated heavy to very heavy rain and gusty wind will then spread to the lower Northeast and the Central region, including Bangkok. The East and the upper South will also see the heavier rain. title: 机场哭声一片！泰国学生赴华研学行程泡汤，多所学校卷入纠纷
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国涉及多所学校学生及家长的赴华研学项目纠纷持续发酵。10月16日最新披露显示，受影响的学校已从此前3所增至11所，涉及学生62人，涉案金额达数百万泰铢。学生们原计划前往中国学习语言、了解当地文化，却在出发当天抵达机场准备办理登机手续时，发现没有预订机票，航空系统中也查不到相关乘客信息，赴华行程被迫取消。机场现场一度充满失望与哭声，学生及家长均受到严重打击。 据消息人士透露，这起“幽灵研学团”事件由一名自称拥有博士头衔的人士与另一名相关人员共同组织，原计划于2026年10月15日至26日开展中国短期学习课程，每名学生收费39,900泰铢。组织方声称已与中国西安交通大学签署谅解备忘录（MOU）。首日报案数据显示，共有来自曼谷、暖武里府及春武里府3所学校的45名学生报名，涉及款项总额达1,795,500泰铢，家长已将费用转入负责组织项目的教师账户。 10月11日，组织方通知家长，因西安宿舍无法容纳全部学生，决定将目的地改为北京，出行日期维持不变。10月13日上午，组织方再次召开会议，确认将按计划前往北京，并要求师生及家长于10月15日15时抵达素万那普机场，搭乘原定18时20分起飞的泰越捷航空航班。 然而10月15日当天，教师、学生及家长抵达机场后，突然接到通知称没有预订机票。家长向泰越捷航空工作人员核实后，也得到无法按计划出行的答复。 报道指出，涉事组织方涉嫌冒用身份及职务背景获取信任。相关人员自称“博士”，并声称自己是泰国基础教育委员会办公室的公务人员，借助所谓的专业资历和官方背景推销赴华学习课程，令来自11所以上学校的家长相信其说辞，并为子女支付相关费用。 面对行程取消，项目组织方曾承诺于10月15日向家长全额退款，但截至约定期限，退款并未全部兑现。报道称，各学校退款情况不一：部分学校的家长已收到全额退款，部分家长仅收到部分款项，另有一所学校的家长仍未收到任何退款。 10月15日深夜，3所学校的相关报案人及家长前往素万那普机场警察局报案，要求警方将情况记录在案，以便收集证据，向案件发生地所属警察局提出正式刑事控告。10月16日，更多受影响家长已向媒体求助，希望通过报道揭露事件，并准备整理证据向警方报案，要求依法追究涉事“博士”及其他相关人员的责任。 家长表示，此事不仅造成经济损失，也给学生带来严重的心理伤害，并影响其原定的学习安排。目前，相关事件仍有待警方进一步调查，涉事人员是否冒用身份、是否涉嫌诈骗及实际损失金额，均应以警方调查结果为准。 （编译：Wan；来源：Thairath、Matichon） The post 机场哭声一片！泰国学生赴华研学行程泡汤，多所学校卷入纠纷 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国承诺亚残运结束后7天内发放奖金 金牌选手可获100万泰铢
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月16日，泰国体育局局长普罗巴兰表示，在第五届亚洲残疾人运动会备战期间，泰国体育局已全力为国家残疾人运动队提供经费支持，包括运动员集训期间的津贴等，目前各项工作均无问题。 第五届亚洲残疾人运动会“2026爱知·名古屋”将于2026年10月18日至24日在日本爱知县名古屋市举行。泰国体育局将与泰国残奥委员会、泰国残疾人体育协会、泰国盲人体育协会、泰国脑瘫人士体育协会以及泰国智力障碍人士体育协会等机构合作，派出265名运动员参加全部18个大项的比赛。 泰国代表团的目标是不低于上一届赛事的成绩，即至少获得27枚金牌。泰方有望在多个项目中争取奖牌，包括轮椅竞速、田径、乒乓球、轮椅击剑、羽毛球、硬地滚球、射击、游泳、射箭、自行车、举重和跆拳道等。 她表示，泰国国家体育发展基金将按照相关规定，在赛事结束后7天内向运动员发放奖金，鼓励运动员继续努力。泰国残疾人运动员在赛场上取得佳绩，为国家赢得荣誉，也为泰国民众带来喜悦。相关奖励安排与参加第二十届亚洲运动会的泰国运动员相同。 泰国残疾人运动员长期坚持集训，并持续参加各类赛事，因此在国际赛事、残奥会、亚洲残疾人运动会及东南亚残疾人运动会等赛事中具备较强竞争力。运动员取得成绩、获得奖牌后，生活质量得到改善，知名度也有所提升，并能够激励更多年轻运动员投身体育事业。 根据泰国国家体育发展基金的奖励规定，亚洲残疾人运动会奖牌奖金标准如下：金牌获得者可获100万泰铢，银牌获得者可获50万泰铢，铜牌获得者可获25万泰铢。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：matichon） The post 泰国承诺亚残运结束后7天内发放奖金 金牌选手可获100万泰铢 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国反IMF和世界银行示威持续 警方部署800余名警力加强安保
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月16日，泰国反对世界银行和国际货币基金组织（IMF）的民间团体在曼谷拉玛四路附近举行示威，抗议相关国际金融机构的经济发展政策。示威地点靠近诗丽吉国家会议中心，该中心正在举办2026年国际货币基金组织和世界银行集团年会。示威者自10月15日起在当地集会，并于夜间留守，计划在会议期间持续关注相关动态、表达诉求。 示威团体表示，此次集会旨在反映受到经济政策影响的民众的声音，并反对泰国政府与世界银行开展相关合作。示威者认为，世界银行未能给民众带来实际利益，部分经济发展政策可能加重债务负担、扩大社会不平等，并对社区造成影响。示威者还提及1997年以来民众因向世界银行借款及相关项目受到的影响，呼吁泰国政府和国际金融机构重新审视经济发展政策，对过往项目造成的损害承担责任，并为受影响民众提供补偿。 16日11时20分左右，示威团体举行象征性活动。参与者吹起绿色和黑色气球，并印上“NO WORLD BANK & NO IMF”（不要世界银行，不要国际货币基金组织）字样。示威者称，气球象征着该团体的呼吸，随后将气球集中装入黑色塑料袋，交给在道路对面维持秩序的警察，现场代表将袋中的气球倒出，以此表达反对立场。 警方对会议周边采取了严格的安全措施，泰国京畿警察局及多个辖区的警力部署在现场，防暴警察也做好准备并轮班执勤。警方依据2015年《公共集会法》向示威者发布相关告示，同时设置铁制护栏、防暴盾牌、押送车辆、集装箱及塑料隔离墩，形成多道防线，并在拉玛四路一侧设置集装箱和路障，封闭了部分道路。警方部署了800余名着装及便衣警员监控现场情况，并安排交通警察疏导Sukhumvit路沿线交通，尽量减少对民众出行的影响。示威区域另有200余名警员加强巡逻和安保。 由于示威者在会议中心附近通宵集会，警方对周边道路实施了交通管制。16日，会议中心前的Ratchadaphisek路及Khlong Toei市场一侧的道路受到封闭影响，参会人员需在指定地点下车，步行进入会议中心；部分人员选择乘坐摩托车出租车抵达拉玛四路附近，再步行前往会场。 警方还宣布，16日凌晨0时01分至20时，将封闭Ratchadaphisek路从Asok Montri路口至Ratchada–拉玛四路口的路段，并对拉玛四路和Ratchadaphisek路靠近会议中心的部分路口实施转向限制。警方提醒公众提前查询交通信息、避开封闭路段，并遵循现场工作人员指引。 此外，曼谷地铁（MRT）诗丽吉国家会议中心站于当天9时至16时暂停服务，配合会议期间的安全保障工作。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：khaosod thairath） The post 泰国反IMF和世界银行示威持续 警方部署800余名警力加强安保 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 反抗国际金融机构示威升级：曼谷部署800警力应对IMF和世界银行会议
summary_cn: IMF与世界银行2026年年会在曼谷诗丽吉国家会议中心举行，引发民众强烈反对。示威者抗议国际金融机构政策加重债务负担、扩大贫富差距，回溯至1997年的历史伤痛。警方出动800多名警员维持秩序，在Sukhumvit路、Ratchadaphisek路等关键路段设置路障、实施交通管制，曼谷地铁诗丽吉站暂停服务，力图维护会议安全和城市秩序。

title: Five African women arrested for visa overstays on Koh Samui
desc: Five African women arrested for visa overstays on Koh Samui Legacy Five African women have been arrested at a hotel near Chaweng Beach on Koh Samui after immigration officers discovered they had overstayed their visas by up to 799 days. Surat Thani immigration police announced the arrests today, October 16, following a tip-off that foreign women were allegedly approaching tourists to offer sexual services in local nightlife areas. Officers checked accommodation records under Section 38 of the Immigration Act before contacting the owner of a hotel in Bo Phut, Koh Samui district, Surat Thani province. They found nine foreign women staying at the property, five of whom had remained in Thailand beyond their permitted stay. Photo via MGR Online The longest overstay involved 32 year old Ugandan Babra Khemiremmi, whose permission to remain had expired 799 days earlier. The other four were 31 year old Tanzanian Dora Sawara, who had overstayed by 487 days; 33 year old Tanzanian Prisca Gowi, 388 days; 37 year old Ugandan Tracy Tukamuebwa, 224 days; and 32 year old Ugandan Anita Akanwasa, 105 days. All five were charged with remaining in Thailand after their permission to stay had expired. Ph

title: Bangkok man arrested over fake study seeking teen nude photos
desc: Bangkok man arrested over fake study seeking teen nude photos Legacy A Bangkok hotel employee has been arrested over an alleged fake university study used to deceive teenage boys into sending explicit images and videos, with investigators seizing more than 5,000 files during a search of his condominium. The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) announced the arrest yesterday, October 15, following an investigation into allegations that the suspect impersonated university lecturers and coerced some victims into sexual activity . The suspect, identified only as 26 year old Bancha, was arrested at a condominium in Bangkok’s Charoen Nakhon area on Wednesday, October 14, during an operation codenamed Black Research. DSI officers, working with child protection organisation OUR Rescue, executed a court warrant after investigators linked the man to an alleged scheme involving male secondary school students who were aged 15 to 17 at the time. Investigators seized more than 5,000 explicit files, including over 3,000 suspected to contain child sexual abuse material and approximately 2,000 involving adults. A laptop, two mobile phones and an iPad were also confiscated. Photo via Newn

title: 泰国托运行李新规今起实施，若可疑将直接开箱后通知
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月16日，泰国总理府办公室副发言人普洛塔莱透露，此前公布的托运行李检查新规于今天起正式实施，若托运行李在检查时发现可疑物品，检查人员可未经事先通知直接打开托运行李。她强调，新规是为了提高航空安全水平，符合全球多个国家和地区采用的国际标准和通行做法，同时，只有在X光机检测到可疑物品或可能影响飞行安全物品时，工作人员才会采取未经事先通知开箱检查的措施。 按照规定，开箱检查将在指定区域进行，每个环节均会全程录像留存证据，以便事后核查操作人员身份和所查获的物品，检查完成后，系统将依法向乘客告知其行李已被依规开箱检查。这一做法属于多地区通行的航空安全标准，新加坡、日本、韩国、中东及欧洲、美国等均已采用，其目的是防止可能危害飞行安全的物品被带上飞机，同时提高航班运行的管理效率，减少因寻找行李主人配合开箱而导致的航班延误。 普洛塔莱表示，建议乘客优先选择符合国际标准的行李锁具，如TSA锁（海关锁），在必要的情况下，安检人员可以使用专用工具将其开启，且不会造成行李箱损坏。另外，乘客在出行前应仔细核对违禁品清单或可能需要接受特殊检查的物品目录，因为全球多家机场都已实施类似措施，行程中的始发地、中转及目的地均有可能进行追加检查，一旦发现违反当地法律的物品，可能会影响后续行程。 如果乘客在上述措施执行过程中遇到问题或遭受损失，可通过所搭乘的航空公司进行投诉，或通过泰国民航局（CAAT）的投诉系统提交申诉，以便依法核查事实并开展后续相关处理。 （编译：KA；来源：ch7） The post 泰国托运行李新规今起实施，若可疑将直接开箱后通知 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国托运行李新规今起实施，可疑物品不提前通知直接开箱
summary_cn: 泰国总理府办公室副发言人普洛塔莱10月16日宣布，提高航空安全的托运行李检查新规正式实施。根据新规，当X光机检测到可疑物品或可能危害飞行安全的物品时，检查人员可不经事先通知直接开箱检查。检查将在指定区域进行，全程录像保留证据。检查完成后，系统将依法向乘客通知。该措施符合新加坡、日本、韩国等多国航空安全标准。乘客应准备符合国际标准的行李锁具，并提前了解违禁品清单。如遇问题可向航空公司或泰国民航局投诉。

desc: Construction of the royal crematorium for Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother is more than 90% complete, with the final detailing expected to be finished by the end of this month, the Fine Arts Department said.

summary_cn: 为已故诗丽吉皇太后（Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother）建造的皇家火葬场工程进展顺利，建设完成度已超过90%。泰国文化艺术部门（Fine Arts Department）官方确认，各项工程细节和装修装饰工作预期将在十月底前全部完成。这座庄重的皇家设施见证了泰国对皇室的尊崇和悼念。

title_cn: IMF上调亚洲增长预期至4.8% 同时警示三大风险
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）上调亚洲2026年经济增长预期至4.8%，但同时警告中东冲突、高能源成本、贸易保护主义和厄尔尼诺现象等风险冲击地区。IMF建议泰国政府实施精准救助，同时保持财政纪律以增强经济抵抗力。

title: Julapun rules out scrapping SSO board election
desc: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat said that nullifying the Social Security Board election, which was won by the Progressive Social Security team, was not under consideration and that politicians were not prohibited from encouraging people to vote.
title_cn: 泰国劳工部长排除废止社会保障委员会选举
summary_cn: 泰国劳工部长朱拉蓬·阿蒙维瓦特（Julapun Amornvivat）排除了取消社会保障委员会（SSO）董事会选举的可能性。该选举已被进步社会保障团队赢得。朱拉蓬还澄清，政界人士并未被禁止鼓励民众投票。
desc_original: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat said that nullifying the Social Security Board election, which was won by the Progressive Social Security team, was not under consideration and that politicians were not prohibited from encouraging people to vote.

title: AI seen as key for developing nations
desc: Artificial intelligence (AI) can help emerging markets enhance productivity, bridge skill gaps and reduce costs through localisation, according to AI venture capitalists and startups at the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok.
title_cn: 人工智能被视为发展中国家的关键助力
summary_cn: 在曼谷举行的国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行年会上，AI风险投资家和初创企业认为，人工智能能帮助泰国等新兴市场显著提高生产力、缩小技能差距，并通过本地化方案降低运营成本。这为泰国加快数字化转型、提升产业竞争力提供了新的战略思路。与会专家强调，AI应用不仅推动经济增长，也创造了新的就业机会。
desc_original: Artificial intelligence (AI) can help emerging markets enhance productivity, bridge skill gaps and reduce costs through localisation, according to AI venture capitalists and startups at the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok.

title: Pheu Thai assures BJT of its support
desc: Pheu Thai yesterday pledged to support the Bhumjaithai-led government during the upcoming no-confidence debate, with party leader Yodchanan Wongsawat expressing confidence in the administration's performance.
title_cn: 为泰党表示支持同红党政府度过信任投票
summary_cn: 为泰党党领导人约达南·翁沙瓦（Yodchanan Wongsawat）宣布，该党将在即将进行的信任投票中全力支持同红党（Bhumjaithai）领导的政府，并对现政府的整体表现表示充分信心。为泰党作为执政联盟重要成员的这一表态，对泰国政局稳定具有重要意义，有利于政府顺利推进各项政策，避免政治困局影响国计民生。
desc_original: Pheu Thai yesterday pledged to support the Bhumjaithai-led government during the upcoming no-confidence debate, with party leader Yodchanan Wongsawat expressing confidence in the administration's performance.

title: Pundits call for use of farm land for wind energy projects
desc: Energy investors are calling on the government to allow development of wind farms on Sor Por Kor agricultural reform land, arguing the move would help lower electricity prices, strengthen energy security and improve farmers' incomes.
title_cn: 专家呼吁在Sor Por Kor农业改革地上开发风电项目
summary_cn: 能源投资者呼吁泰国政府允许在Sor Por Kor农业改革地上开发大规模风电场。他们认为这一举措将有三重好处：降低全国电价，增强国家能源安全，同时提高农民收入。该建议涉及能源政策与农业发展的平衡，需要在可再生能源目标与农民权益之间找到切合点。对于致力于能源转型的泰国而言，这是一个值得关注的政策议题。
desc_original: Energy investors are calling on the government to allow development of wind farms on Sor Por Kor agricultural reform land, arguing the move would help lower electricity prices, strengthen energy security and improve farmers' incomes.

title: Hotel, AoT stocks picked  for growth by analysts
desc: Large international events, including the IMF-World Bank 2026 Annual Meetings, seasonal demand and recently launched campaigns by the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) are helping Thai hotel and Airports of Thailand (AoT) stocks, according to analysts.
title_cn: 分析师看好泰国酒店及机场股票增长前景
summary_cn: 市场分析师表示，IMF-世界银行2026年会等国际大型活动的举办、季节性旅游需求的回升，以及泰国旅游局（TAT）最近推出的各项促销活动，共同推动泰国酒店股和泰国机场公司（AoT）股票的增长。这些利好因素包括会议带来的商务旅客增加、境外游客的季节性涌入等，为相关上市公司提供了可观的增长机遇。
desc_original: Large international events, including the IMF-World Bank 2026 Annual Meetings, seasonal demand and recently launched campaigns by the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) are helping Thai hotel and Airports of Thailand (AoT) stocks, according to analysts.

title: BLA turns focus to longevity market
desc: Bangkok Life Assurance (BLA) is expanding its life insurance and healthcare services to tap opportunities in Thailand's longevity market, as longer life expectancy raises concerns over medical costs, financial security and the burden on families.
title_cn: 曼谷人寿保险公司聚焦长寿经济新机遇
summary_cn: 曼谷人寿保险公司（BLA）正在大幅扩展其寿险和医疗保健服务，以抓住泰国「长寿经济」市场的商机。随着泰国人口预期寿命的延长，医疗开支上升、财务安全保障、家庭负担等问题日益迫切。BLA通过推出创新保险产品和服务，帮助民众规划长期健康和财务保障，满足人口老龄化趋势带来的新兴市场需求。
desc_original: Bangkok Life Assurance (BLA) is expanding its life insurance and healthcare services to tap opportunities in Thailand's longevity market, as longer life expectancy raises concerns over medical costs, financial security and the burden on families.

title: “停止毁灭世界的资本”：IMF与世行年会之际，曼谷千余民众走上街头
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月15日，当全球金融领袖齐聚曼谷诗丽吉王后国家会议中心、出席世界银行与国际货币基金组织（IMF）理事会年会时，会场外的曼谷街头，另一场“会议”正在进行。反对世行与IMF的民间组织网络联合非政府组织协调委员会发起集会，用游行、横幅与演讲，向会场内外的世界传递同一句话：土地、债务、环境——这些议题，不该由“1%的人”决定。 这是自1991年以来，曼谷时隔35年再次承办IMF与世行集团年会。10月12日至18日，这场全球金融界最重量级的年度聚会，将这座城市的奢华酒店与贫民窟、现代高架与老城区，同时推到了世界镜头前。 游行现场：示威者高举横幅，警方设置路障 当天上午8时，示威者在海关路口集合，随后沿港口路行进，转入纳兰农路，途经孔堤社区，向会议中心方向前进。目的地是孔堤路口，即拉玛四世路与拉差达披色路的交汇处，也是距离会议中心最近的路口之一。队伍中有老人、学生，也有社区代表。有人拖着粉色的猪形充气道具，眼睛做成美元符号，讽刺资本集团的贪婪。也有人戴着特朗普、IMF总裁格奥尔基耶娃等人物的面具，矛头指向会场内的决策者。 横幅与标语牌上的英文口号格外醒目： “停止毁灭世界的资本，人民决定自己的未来——NO WORLD BANK X IMF” “土地不可出售（LAND is not for SALE）” “生活不属于IMF和世行（LIFE is not for IMF World Bank）” “富人更富，穷人缴税” “河流要生命，不要水坝” 上午9时许，队伍抵达孔堤路口。警方已在路口列队，并设置铁栏与防撞路障，不允许示威者进入会议区域。此前，曼谷警方已宣布在会议中心、主要会场及代表下榻的酒店周边禁止集会。双方对峙约5分钟后，警方允许示威者在路口开展象征性抗议活动，示威者随即在原地发表演讲。集会对交通影响明显。拉玛四世路与孔堤路口周边严重拥堵，部分路段一度无法通行。 天桥冲突：双方争夺横幅，警方否认下令使用暴力 上午9时27分左右，部分示威者试图登上拉玛四世路交叉口附近的人行天桥悬挂横幅，警方上前阻止，双方随即发生拉扯，争夺横幅的过程持续超过7分钟。 一名在演讲车上发言的组织负责人表示，悬挂横幅不应被视为犯罪，并呼吁警方停止使用暴力，称相关行为可能损害国际社会对泰国的信任。他同时要求警方停止阻挠集会，尊重民众表达意见的权利。 经过一番拉扯，示威者最终将横幅从人行天桥另一侧放下，横幅上写着“停止毁灭世界的资本，人民决定自己的未来”。现场画面显示，横幅部分区域出现撕裂。 据现场记者报道，冲突造成部分示威者受伤。示威者还指称，警方曾试图使用束线带控制现场人员，并呼吁到场观察集会的泰国国家人权委员会成员关注执法情况，保障示威者的权利与自由。 关于天桥事件的具体经过，不同媒体的报道存在一定差异。部分报道将其描述为一场短暂的肢体冲突，另有报道指出，警方最初以安全

summary_cn: 在全球债务激增、国际援助减少的背景下，国家需要强化财政纪律以应对经济危机。国际货币基金组织（IMF）建议各国加快创建财政空间、优化支出结构，在资源有限的情况下推动经济发展。这些政策教训对泰国等面临高债务压力的发展中国家具有重要参考意义，有助于在外部金融环境收紧时维持经济稳定增长。

title: Internet cable found between border house and Myanmar casino
desc: KANCHANABURI: Authorities found an internet cable illegally laid from a border house in Sangkhla Buri district to a possible casino in Myanmar on Thursday.
title_cn: 尖竹汶边界发现连接缅甸赌场的网线
summary_cn: 泰国当局在尖竹汶府 Kanchanaburi 桑卡拉武里区 Sangkhla Buri 的边界住宅处发现一条非法网线，该网线被铺设至缅甸境内的疑似赌场设施。此举暴露了跨境违法赌博设施的存在，这些设施利用网络基础设施进行非法博彩活动，可能涉及外国人参与。当局已介入调查，旨在切断边界地区的非法在线赌博网络，维护金融安全。
desc_original: KANCHANABURI: Authorities found an internet cable illegally laid from a border house in Sangkhla Buri district to a possible casino in Myanmar on Thursday.

title: Government confident of economic strengths
desc: The government has stressed that Thailand retains significant economic strengths despite forecasts that its growth will be the slowest among the Asean-5 economies.
title_cn: 泰国政府对经济实力充满信心
summary_cn: 泰国政府强调，尽管国际预测显示泰国今年经济增速将是东盟五国中最缓慢，但该国仍保有显著的经济优势和发展潜力。政府官员表示泰国具有稳定的基础设施、多元化产业结构和充分的外汇储备，足以应对外部经济挑战，维持经济持续增长，国家经济基本面保持稳健。
desc_original: The government has stressed that Thailand retains significant economic strengths despite forecasts that its growth will be the slowest among the Asean-5 economies.

title: Media experts urge safeguards for Thai PBS
desc: Replacing earmarked tax funding with annual government budget allocations for Thai PBS could expose the public broadcaster to greater political influence, say media academics, who have called for stronger financial transparency and more diverse revenue sources.
title_cn: 媒体专家呼吁保护泰国公共广播电视台
summary_cn: 媒体学者警告，将泰国公共广播电视台（Thai PBS）财政从专款改为年度政府预算拨款，可能导致其面临更大政治影响压力。专家呼吁加强财务透明度、拓展多元化收入来源，以保护公共广播独立性。
desc_original: Replacing earmarked tax funding with annual government budget allocations for Thai PBS could expose the public broadcaster to greater political influence, say media academics, who have called for stronger financial transparency and more diverse revenue sources.

title: 76 deaths attributed to floods since mid-September
desc: Seventy-six people have died across Thailand since mid-September because of flooding, including 25 in Prachin Buri province alone, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.
title_cn: 泰国洪灾自9月中旬以来已造成76人丧生
summary_cn: 根据泰国灾难防治与减灾部门统计，自9月中旬以来全国洪灾已导致76人死亡，其中巴真府（Prachin Buri）就有25人遇难。灾情仍在持续，相关部门正加强防灾工作。
desc_original: Seventy-six people have died across Thailand since mid-September because of flooding, including 25 in Prachin Buri province alone, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

title: Swiss president making first Thai visit in 22 years
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Thursday welcomed Swiss President Guy Parmelin for an official visit aimed at expanding trade and investment and strengthening bilateral cooperation, as the two countries prepare to mark the 95th anniversary of diplomatic relations.
title_cn: 瑞士总统22年来首次访泰
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）周四欢迎瑞士总统基·帕默林（Guy Parmelin）进行官方访问，旨在扩大贸易投资，加强两国双边合作。此访标志着两国即将迎来外交关系95周年纪念。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Thursday welcomed Swiss President Guy Parmelin for an official visit aimed at expanding trade and investment and strengthening bilateral cooperation, as the two countries prepare to mark the 95th anniversary of diplomatic relations.

title: What to do in Bangkok this November 2026
desc: What to do in Bangkok this November 2026 Legacy November is when Bangkok finally exhales. The rains ease off, the humidity drops a notch, and the city slides into its golden window of cool, dry evenings that locals wait all year for. It is also the month of Loy Krathong , when the Chao Phraya glows with candlelit baskets and the whole city turns riverward. Add a packed calendar of concerts, travel fairs, night markets and street festivals, and November might just be the best month of the year to be in the Thai capital. Here is our pick of what to do in Bangkok this November 2026. Loy Krathong 2026: the city’s big night Thailand’s most photogenic festival falls on the full moon of the twelfth lunar month, which in 2026 lands on Tuesday 24 November . On this one night, Thais float krathongs — small baskets of banana leaf, flowers, incense and a candle — onto rivers and ponds to pay respect to the water goddess and let go of the past year’s misfortunes. In Bangkok the action is all along the water. Good spots to float a krathong and soak up the atmosphere include: Asiatique The Riverfront — riverside floating with traditional performances and food stalls, easy to reach by the free shu

title: South Korean man held after Thai woman reports Pattaya assault
desc: South Korean man held after Thai woman reports Pattaya assault Legacy A South Korean man was arrested in Pattaya after a caller reported that a 44 year old Thai woman had been assaulted and confined inside a room , with immigration checks later showing he had overstayed by 274 days . The request for help came at around 10pm on October 10, when the caller told Chon Buri immigration officers that their mother was being held by the man inside a room in Nong Prue subdistrict, Bang Lamung district. Immigration investigators coordinated with Pattaya City Police and went to the room, where they arrested a 40 year old South Korean man identified by the pseudonym Younjin. Photo via MGR Online A check of his immigration status found that his permission to remain in Thailand had expired 274 days earlier. He was charged with overstaying and transferred to Pattaya City Police Station for further legal proceedings. No charge relating to the alleged assault or confinement was reported. The arrest was the first of three overstay cases handled by Chon Buri immigration officers in Pattaya between October 10 and 14. title: 泰国斯米兰群岛重新开放啦！
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，10月15日，泰国斯米兰群岛和素林群岛重新开放，迎来2026-2027旅游季首批游客。经过近5个月的封岛休养，来自泰国及海外的游客纷纷乘船登岛，欣赏当地海洋与自然景观，旅游码头也重新恢复热闹景象。 斯米兰群岛开放首日，不少泰国及外国游客报名一日游前往这片以海水清澈、沙滩洁白和海洋生态丰富而闻名的旅游胜地。攀牙府Thai Mueang县Lam Kaen镇的Thap Lamu村一带，各家旅游公司的码头重新热闹起来，游客陆续抵达办理登记手续，准备乘船出海。 出发前，工作人员向游客介绍斯米兰群岛的历史与自然特色，讲解乘船出行及进入国家公园后的注意事项。相关安排旨在确保游客遵守国家公园管理规定及旅游公司的安全要求，在欣赏自然景观的同时，共同保护当地生态环境。 本次开放时间为2026年10月15日至2027年5月15日。游客可以再次欣赏群岛独特的自然风光，包括色彩斑斓的珊瑚、细软洁白的沙滩以及海中成群的小鱼等丰富的海洋生态景观。 其中，斯米兰群岛第8号岛上的标志性帆船石尤为引人注目。这块独特的岩石矗立于山崖之上，是当地最具代表性的自然景观之一。此外，群岛还设有自然生态游览路线，供游客近距离感受当地的自然环境。 随着斯米兰群岛和素林群岛重新开放，泰国知名海岛旅游目的地正式迎来新一轮旅游季。不过，游客在规划行程时仍应留意天气与海况，遵守国家公园的相关规定，在享受海岛美景的同时保护脆弱的海洋生态。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgronline） The post 泰国斯米兰群岛重新开放啦！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国斯米兰群岛重新开放迎接新旅游季
summary_cn: 泰国斯米兰群岛（Similan Islands）和素林群岛（Surin Islands）于10月15日重新开放，完成近5个月的保护性封岛。开放期为2026年10月15日至2027年5月15日。游客可乘船欣赏清澈海水、洁白沙滩和丰富海洋生态。群岛第8号岛上的「帆船石」（Sail Rock）是标志性景观。攀牙府泰妙县码头已重新活跃，游客需遵守国家公园规定，在享受海岛美景同时保护脆弱生态环境。

title: Thailand, Switzerland push EFTA deal and US$120m carbon plan
desc: Thailand, Switzerland push EFTA deal and US$120m carbon plan Legacy Thailand and Switzerland are moving to fast-track implementation of their EFTA free trade agreement while advancing plans for about US$120 million in carbon-credit purchases . Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Swiss President Guy Parmelin discussed the plans in Bangkok today, October 15, during Parmelin’s official visit to Thailand on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings 2026. The visit comes as Thailand and Switzerland prepare to mark 95 years of diplomatic relations and is the first official visit by a Swiss president to Thailand in 22 years. Trade and investment were among the main topics. Switzerland was Thailand’s largest trading partner in Europe in 2025 and remained so during the first nine months of this year. The two governments agreed to push ahead with implementation of the Thailand-European Free Trade Association, or EFTA, agreement as quickly as possible to expand trade and investment opportunities and improve business competitiveness. title: Chinese ex-flight attendant held for aiding illegal border crossings
desc: Chinese ex-flight attendant held for aiding illegal border crossings Legacy A former Chinese flight attendant studying in Thailand has been arrested in Songkhla after police accused her of acting as a broker for Chinese nationals travelling illegally between Thailand and Malaysia. The 34 year old woman, identified by the pseudonym Pan Yudong, was among five people arrested today, October 15, as immigration officers investigated a smuggling route through southern Thailand. The case began after Songkhla immigration officers learned that two Chinese men had crossed illegally from Malaysia and were staying at a hotel in central Hat Yai while waiting for someone from Bangkok to collect them. Officers watched the hotel and saw the two men, identified by the pseudonyms Huang Guanggang and Huang Fu Yi, leave their room and wait in the car park. Photo via Facebook: ภูมริน มหันตมรรค Pan then arrived in a hired vehicle to pick them up. Pan then arrived in a hired vehicle to pick up the two men. Officers moved in, identified themselves and asked to inspect the group’s passports. During the checks, both men admitted entering Thailand through an unofficial border crossing in Narathiwat province.

title: Hua Hin beach buildings face phased demolition from Oct 16
desc: Hua Hin beach buildings face phased demolition from Oct 16 Legacy Hua Hin beach demolition work is set to begin tomorrow, October 16, with contractors preparing to remove parts of 15 waterfront buildings following a final court ruling ordering the return of public beachfront land . The operation covers structures between Hua Hin Fishing Pier and the Chao Mae Thap Thim Shrine in Prachuap Khiri Khan province, beginning with vacant properties and sections that can be dismantled without disturbing residents. The arrangements were agreed during a meeting on October 14, attended by Hua Hin Mayor Nopporn Wutthikul and representatives from the police, Marine Department, land agencies and utility providers. The first phase will focus on extensions projecting into the sea, signs and non-residential structures. Officials will return on October 22 for a final inspection before proceeding with the remaining buildings. title: 6 reasons health insurance claims get rejected even with coverage
desc: 6 reasons health insurance claims get rejected even with coverage Legacy Having health insurance doesn’t necessarily mean your insurer will pay every hospital bill , even when the treatment seems to fall within coverage. If your health insurance rejected a claim, the explanation may be more specific than simply having no coverage. You could visit a private hospital in Thailand, follow your doctor’s recommendations and submit a claim, only to discover that part or all of the cost won’t be reimbursed. Sometimes the reason is an exclusion you overlooked, while other times it comes down to missing paperwork, approval requirements or the way your benefits are calculated. A rejected health insurance claim, a delayed payment and a partially approved claim are also three different situations, although they can feel much the same when you’re left paying the hospital yourself. Here are six reasons why this happens and what you can do to avoid an unexpected bill. title: 经合组织秘书长盛赞泰国为区域成功典范
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月14日，泰国总理秘书长岱素丽透露，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）秘书长Mathias Cormann在2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行集团年会的官方平行边会“Future-Ready Economy 2026”上发表了致辞，其中表达了国际社会对泰国经济发展成果的认可，体现出泰国和东南亚地区在全球经济中日益提升的作用。 Mathias Cormann表示，这一周全球经济对话的焦点都集中在了曼谷，这是泰国时隔35年后再次主办IMF与世界银行年会，既展现了泰国的进步，也反映出东南亚对全球经济的重要性。他盛赞泰国是“本地区最伟大的成功故事之一”，因为泰国坚持对外开放、促进经济增长，并改善了数千万民众的生活质量。 与此同时，Mathias Cormann强调，加入OECD不仅对泰国有利，OECD本身也将因泰国的视角和经验而变得更加强韧。泰国具备能够参与塑造未来经济合作走向的份量，OECD希望泰国的声音能在制定国际标准的舞台上发挥作用。 岱素丽指出，Mathias Cormann的发言不仅是将泰国视为一场世界级会议的主办国，更是对泰国经济成就、国家潜力和泰国未来在国际舞台上所发挥作用的认可。泰国正在从国际标准的接受者和应用者，转变为与OECD成员共同制定标准的参与者，泰国已经选定了这条路，而OECD也非常自豪能在每一个阶段与泰国携手同行。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandard） The post 经合组织秘书长盛赞泰国为区域成功典范 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 芭堤雅“东芭世界”携手“携程”拓展全球市场
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月14日，泰国“芭堤雅东芭世界”（原“芭堤雅东芭乐园”）宣布，公司已与携程国际旅游（香港）有限公司签署了合作谅解备忘录（MOU），借助其在线旅行服务平台Trip.com开展市场营销和品牌推广，以吸引更多国际游客，并在海外建立全新的品牌认知，将泰国旅游业提升至国际水平。本次MOU的签约仪式由芭堤雅东芭世界主席甘蓬与携程东南亚大区旅游业发展总经理Allen Peng代表签署，内容包括针对海外目标客群进行推广，以及对各项设施升级方案的研究，目的是改善游客的整体出行体验。 甘蓬透露，与携程合作不仅是为了增加游客数量，更是双方优势有机结合，为泰国旅游业开辟新机遇。芭堤雅东芭世界已准备好持续推出新的游玩体验，让旧地重游的游客能有新惊喜，同时吸引没有来过的游客亲自来体验。 新名字“东芭世界”体现了园区从单纯的植物园升级为适合全家出游的娱乐王国，这里汇集了众多特色亮点，如70多个主题花园、恐龙谷、埃及小镇、泰国传统文化表演和丰富的科普研学区。园区将在“不只是美丽的花园，更是属于每个家庭的世界”这一概念下，结合“老少皆宜，全家共享”的口号，进一步巩固“东芭世界”作为芭堤雅家庭游首选目的地的形象。 （编译：KA；来源：ejan） The post 芭堤雅“东芭世界”携手“携程”拓展全球市场 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

summary_cn: 今日油价信息更新，10月15日最新版本。涵盖汽油、酒精混合汽油和柴油等多种油品，对接泰国主要油站品牌包括PTT、Bangchak、PT、Caltex、Susco和Shell的最新零售价。该信息直接关系到日常用车出行成本，是消费者和运输企业的重要参考。

title: Grab turns AI into an earnings instrument
desc: Grab and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to provide free access to ChatGPT Plus and artificial intelligence (AI) training to drivers and small merchants, targeting more than 3,000 participants in Thailand and 30,000 across Southeast Asia to help them increase earnings and develop new businesses.
title_cn: Grab联手OpenAI 将人工智能转化为收入增长工具
summary_cn: 打车巨头Grab与OpenAI扩大合作，面向泰国和东南亚地区的司机与小商户提供免费ChatGPT Plus订阅和人工智能专业培训。该项目涉及泰国3000多名参与者，东南亚范围达3万人，旨在帮助提升其收入水平和商业竞争力。
desc_original: Grab and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to provide free access to ChatGPT Plus and artificial intelligence (AI) training to drivers and small merchants, targeting more than 3,000 participants in Thailand and 30,000 across Southeast Asia to help them increase earnings and develop new businesses.

title: Thailand Post weathers economic turmoil
desc: Thailand Post posted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) of over 100 million baht during the first six months of this year, despite severe macroeconomic and operational headwinds.
title_cn: 泰国邮政逆势增长 上半年利润超1亿泰铢
summary_cn: 尽管面临宏观经济压力和运营困难，泰国邮政公司上半年仍保持稳健表现，税息折折旧摊销前利润（EBITDA）超过1亿泰铢。这一业绩反映出该企业在经济困难时期的运营韧性和成本控制能力。国家邮政服务的持续盈利对物流体系稳定至关重要。
desc_original: Thailand Post posted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) of over 100 million baht during the first six months of this year, despite severe macroeconomic and operational headwinds.

title: Federation puts flood losses at B6-7bn
desc: More than 2,000 businesses under the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) suffered losses from severe flooding late last month, with total damage estimated at 6-7 billion baht, according to representatives.
title_cn: 泰国工业联合会估洪灾造成60-70亿泰铢损失
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会（FTI）公布洪灾经济损失评估报告。联合会旗下超2000家企业在上月严重洪灾中遭受重大损失，总金额估计在60-70亿泰铢之间。此次自然灾害对泰国制造业、出口贸易和中小企业造成严重冲击，凸显防灾减灾的紧迫性。
desc_original: More than 2,000 businesses under the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) suffered losses from severe flooding late last month, with total damage estimated at 6-7 billion baht, according to representatives.

title: Warning over massive losses from exit tax
desc: Thai tourism could lose between 50-150 billion baht in revenue a year thanks to the proposed departure tax, compared with the 45.9 billion baht it is expected to raise, with airlines opposing the levy due to its poor timing and the likelihood of it undermining the travel sector's competitiveness.
title_cn: 出境税风险评估 泰国旅游业面临巨额损失警告
summary_cn: 针对政府拟议的出境离境税，业界发出严厉警告。据估算，新税收政策可能导致泰国旅游业年收入下滑50-150亿泰铢，远高于预期的45.9亿泰铢税收收入。各大航空公司因实施时机不当和可能削弱国际竞争力而强烈反对该举措。
desc_original: Thai tourism could lose between 50-150 billion baht in revenue a year thanks to the proposed departure tax, compared with the 45.9 billion baht it is expected to raise, with airlines opposing the levy due to its poor timing and the likelihood of it undermining the travel sector's competitiveness.

title: IMF urges Thailand to build up resilience
desc: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged Thailand to strengthen its economic fundamentals and deepen regional trade integration as persistently high global borrowing costs threaten to constrain growth and limit policy flexibility.
title_cn: 国际货币基金组织敦促泰国增强经济韧性
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）敦促泰国加强经济基本面，深化地区贸易一体化，应对全球高融资成本威胁。IMF指出当前国际借贷成本高企正制约泰国经济增长，削弱政策灵活性。该组织建议泰国通过深化区域贸易整合、优化经济结构、增强金融韧性等措施，提升抵御外部冲击能力，为长期稳定增长奠定基础。
desc_original: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged Thailand to strengthen its economic fundamentals and deepen regional trade integration as persistently high global borrowing costs threaten to constrain growth and limit policy flexibility.

title: มหาดไทยเปิดตัว "นารีรัตน์หัตถศิลป์" สมุดภาพประวัติศาสตร์เฉลิมพระเกียรติ 40 พรรษา
desc: เพื่อเผยแพร่พระวิสัยทัศน์และพระกรณียกิจในการสืบสาน รักษา และต่อยอดภูมิปัญญาผ้าไทยและงานหัตถกรรม ให้สามารถก้าวไปพร้อมกับการออกแบบร่วมสมัยและการพัฒนาอย่างยั่งยืน
title_cn: 内政部推出皇家手工艺纪念画册庆祝40周年
summary_cn: 泰国内政部推出以皇家手工艺为主题的纪念画册，纪念文化传承40周年。该项目旨在弘扬泰国手工艺和传统编织技艺，深化对本民族文化遗产的保护和传承。同时融合当代设计理念，推动传统工艺实现可持续发展，让手工艺技能在现代产业背景下焕发新生，为文化发展与经济创新相结合提供示范。
