title: Toyota seeks tax relief for impeded producers
desc: Toyota Thailand is asking the government to consider tax deductions for manufacturers affected by recent flooding.
title_cn: 丰田泰国申请税收减免，援助洪灾受困制造商
summary_cn: 丰田泰国公司向政府提出申请，要求对近期洪灾影响的制造商实施税收减免政策。该举措旨在缓解灾区企业的经济压力，支持供应链恢复，事关泰国汽车产业的稳定发展。
desc_original: Toyota Thailand is asking the government to consider tax deductions for manufacturers affected by recent flooding.

title: เลิกโทษตัวเองไร้วินัย! สสส. เปิดงาน NCDH2026 รื้อระบบสู้ NCDs ให้คนไทยสุขภาพดีง่ายขึ้น
desc: สสส. เปิดเวที NCDH2026 ชวนเปลี่ยนมุมมองโรค NCDs จากเรื่องพฤติกรรมส่วนบุคคลสู่การแก้ปัญหาระดับระบบ ปรับโครงสร้างตลาด และกติกาทางเศรษฐกิจเพื่อสุขภาวะที่ยั่งยืนของคนไทย
title_cn: 摆脱自我惩罚 社保部启动NCDH2026峰会重构非传染病防控体系
summary_cn: 泰国社会保障办公处（NCDH）召开NCDH2026会议，倡导将慢性病防治工作从个人行为纠正转向系统层面改革，通过调整市场结构和经济政策促进泰国民众可持续健康。大会致力于建立更完善的公共卫生防控机制，改善全民健康水平。
desc_original: สสส. เปิดเวที NCDH2026 ชวนเปลี่ยนมุมมองโรค NCDs จากเรื่องพฤติกรรมส่วนบุคคลสู่การแก้ปัญหาระดับระบบ ปรับโครงสร้างตลาด และกติกาทางเศรษฐกิจเพื่อสุขภาวะที่ยั่งยืนของคนไทย

title: มาสด้าลุย CX-6e เอสยูวีไฟฟ้า
desc: มาสด้ารุกเต็มสูบรถยนต์ไฟฟ้าในไทย เปิดตัว The All-Electric Mazda CX-6e เอสยูวีไฟฟ้าสำหรับครอบครัวยุคใหม่ เปิด 2 รุ่น ราคา 1.259-1.299 ล้านบาท หวังขยายทางเลือกในตลาดรถไฟฟ้าอเนกประสงค์พรีเมียม
title_cn: 马自达推出CX-6e电动SUV 丰富泰国新能源车型选择
summary_cn: 马自达在泰国发布全新纯电动SUV「The All-Electric Mazda CX-6e」，推出两款车型，售价125.9万至129.9万泰铢，定位于新时代家庭用户。该车型助力马自达扩大在泰国高端电动SUV市场的份额，促进消费者对新能源汽车的选择。
desc_original: มาสด้ารุกเต็มสูบรถยนต์ไฟฟ้าในไทย เปิดตัว The All-Electric Mazda CX-6e เอสยูวีไฟฟ้าสำหรับครอบครัวยุคใหม่ เปิด 2 รุ่น ราคา 1.259-1.299 ล้านบาท หวังขยายทางเลือกในตลาดรถไฟฟ้าอเนกประสงค์พรีเมียม

title: Centara unveils Global Payments alliance
desc: Global Payments Inc has expanded its cross-border payment capabilities in Thailand through a partnership with Centara Hotels & Resorts (CHR).
title_cn: Centara酒店集团携手Global Payments拓展国际支付服务
summary_cn: Global Payments Inc通过与泰国Centara Hotels & Resorts建立战略合作，进一步扩展其在泰国的跨境支付能力。双方合作旨在为游客和商务人士提供更便捷的国际支付解决方案，促进泰国旅游业和商业交易的国际化发展。
desc_original: Global Payments Inc has expanded its cross-border payment capabilities in Thailand through a partnership with Centara Hotels & Resorts (CHR).

title: Weather disruption muddies Q4 sales
desc: Thailand's floods are expected to slightly affect domestic car sales in the fourth quarter as consumers delay purchases and dealerships face delivery disruptions, according to Mazda Sales (Thailand).
title_cn: 泰国洪灾冲击第四季度车市 购车延期交付受阻
summary_cn: 泰国近期洪灾预计将对第四季度国内汽车销售造成轻微影响。消费者因灾情延迟购车计划，汽车经销商面临交付延误问题。根据泰国马自达销售公司预测，灾害天气状况将持续对车市购销活动构成压力。
desc_original: Thailand's floods are expected to slightly affect domestic car sales in the fourth quarter as consumers delay purchases and dealerships face delivery disruptions, according to Mazda Sales (Thailand).

title: Draft law offers novel incentives
desc: The Revenue Department is drafting a new investment promotion law to replace the tax incentives currently provided by the Board of Investment (BoI).
title_cn: 新投资促进法草案出台 取代工业委员会税收优惠政策
summary_cn: 泰国财政部正起草新的投资促进法，拟用以替代泰国工业委员会（Board of Investment，BoI）目前实施的税收优惠政策。新法案旨在创新投资激励机制，为国内外投资者提供更优化的政策环境，进一步推动泰国经济投资吸引力。
desc_original: The Revenue Department is drafting a new investment promotion law to replace the tax incentives currently provided by the Board of Investment (BoI).

title: Analysts predict SET to reach 1,680 by year-end
desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index is expected to finish at 1,680 points by year-end, supported by investment in artificial intelligence (AI) technology and its supply chain, listed-company earnings, foreign fund inflows and a recovery in the domestic economy, says the Investment Analysts Association (IAA).
title_cn: 分析师预测泰国股市年底升至1680点
summary_cn: 泰国投资分析师协会预测，证券交易所（SET）指数有望在今年年底达到1680点。市场支撑因素包括人工智能及其供应链领域的投资增加、上市公司业绩改善、外资基金持续流入以及国内经济复苏。
desc_original: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index is expected to finish at 1,680 points by year-end, supported by investment in artificial intelligence (AI) technology and its supply chain, listed-company earnings, foreign fund inflows and a recovery in the domestic economy, says the Investment Analysts Association (IAA).

title: Regulator beefs up cyber-resilience measures
desc: The insurance industry is reporting more complex cyberthreats powered by artificial intelligence (AI), prompting the Office of the Insurance Commission (OIC) to join hands with 67 life and non-life insurers to strengthen cyber-resilience, from prevention and response to recovery.
title_cn: 泰国保险业加强网络防护措施
summary_cn: 泰国保险业面临人工智能驱动的复杂网络威胁。保险监管委员会（OIC）联合67家寿险及产险公司，从预防、应对到恢复等全环节强化网络防护能力，提升行业网络韧性。
desc_original: The insurance industry is reporting more complex cyberthreats powered by artificial intelligence (AI), prompting the Office of the Insurance Commission (OIC) to join hands with 67 life and non-life insurers to strengthen cyber-resilience, from prevention and response to recovery.

title: Floods cloud country's high-season prospects
desc: The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is reassessing its high-season forecast, accounting for major flooding across several areas of Bangkok and the eastern region while it awaits household relief measures before offering the sector a lift.
title_cn: 洪灾阴云笼罩泰国旅游旺季前景
summary_cn: 泰国旅游局正重新评估年底旺季预期收入。曼谷及东部地区遭遇严重洪灾，旅游部门等待政府家庭救济措施出台后再提振行业。洪灾对高旅游季的影响仍存不确定性。
desc_original: The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is reassessing its high-season forecast, accounting for major flooding across several areas of Bangkok and the eastern region while it awaits household relief measures before offering the sector a lift.

title: Oil Fuel Fund mulls loan options
desc: The Energy Ministry has stressed that borrowing money from banks to shore up the loss-riddled Oil Fuel Fund is a last resort, despite the fund's deficit approaching 100 billion baht.
title_cn: 石油燃料基金探索银行融资方案
summary_cn: 泰国石油燃料基金长期亏损，赤字已接近100亿泰铢。能源部强调向银行借贷是最后手段，基金面临严峻财务困难。政府正研究其他救助融资方案以度过难关。
desc_original: The Energy Ministry has stressed that borrowing money from banks to shore up the loss-riddled Oil Fuel Fund is a last resort, despite the fund's deficit approaching 100 billion baht.

title: Panel seeks to beef up flood preparedness
desc: A private sector panel is preparing a letter to the prime minister urging the government to accelerate efforts to strengthen Thailand's preparedness for future flooding.
title_cn: 民营部门敦促政府加强防洪准备工作
summary_cn: 泰国民营部门正准备致函总理，敦促政府加速推进防洪准备工作。近期严重洪灾凸显国家防灾体系薄弱，业界呼吁政府采取更有力、更前瞻的防灾措施。
desc_original: A private sector panel is preparing a letter to the prime minister urging the government to accelerate efforts to strengthen Thailand's preparedness for future flooding.

title: Bangkok faces submersion risk
desc: Bangkok could have as much as one-third of its area permanently submerged by 2050 if the government fails to overhaul the country's water-management system and take more aggressive action on climate change, environmental and water-management experts warned at a forum.
title_cn: 曼谷面临沉没风险
summary_cn: 环保人士警告，若政府不能改革水资源管理系统、加强气候行动，曼谷到2050年可能有三分之一的区域被永久沉没。这涉及泰国首都的未来发展和防灾规划。
desc_original: Bangkok could have as much as one-third of its area permanently submerged by 2050 if the government fails to overhaul the country's water-management system and take more aggressive action on climate change, environmental and water-management experts warned at a forum.

title: PP rejects 'entertainocracy' tag, insists unity intact
desc: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut insists the party remains united despite criticism from former Future Forward Party (FFP) secretary-general Piyabutr Saengkanokkul over what he calls the rise of "entertainocracy" in politics.
title_cn: 人民党驳斥「娱乐政治」评价，坚称党内团结
summary_cn: 人民党领导人纳塔蓬反驳前未来前进党秘书长皮亚布的批评，否认该党存在「娱乐政治」现象，强调人民党内部保持团结一致。此言论涉及泰国政治派系整合的现状。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut insists the party remains united despite criticism from former Future Forward Party (FFP) secretary-general Piyabutr Saengkanokkul over what he calls the rise of "entertainocracy" in politics.

title: Court rejects NBTC chief's B20m suit for defamation
desc: A civil court has dismissed a 20-million-baht lawsuit filed by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck against four fellow commissioners, ruling their criticisms concerned their official duties and served the public interest.
title_cn: 民事法院驳回广播电视委员会主席诽谤案诉讼
summary_cn: 民事法院驳回广播电视委员会（NBTC）主席萨拉纳博士提出的2000万泰铢诽谤诉讼。法院认为四位同僚的批评与其官职责任相关，符合公众利益。此案涉及监管机构内部的问责机制。
desc_original: A civil court has dismissed a 20-million-baht lawsuit filed by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck against four fellow commissioners, ruling their criticisms concerned their official duties and served the public interest.

title: Skydivers fly Thai flag in record attempt
desc: One Flag Thailand has completed its first world-record mission, flying a 4,303-square-foot Thai national flag over Pattaya.
title_cn: 跳伞健儿飞行泰国国旗创世界纪录
summary_cn: 「一面旗帜泰国」组织在芭提雅上空成功进行跳伞表演，飞行了面积达4303平方英尺的泰国国旗，完成了首次世界纪录任务。这是一项国家精神象征的体育创意活动。
desc_original: One Flag Thailand has completed its first world-record mission, flying a 4,303-square-foot Thai national flag over Pattaya.

title: ThaiHealth funding debate heats up
desc: The government's plan to end ThaiHealth's earmarked alcohol and tobacco tax funding of more than 4 billion baht a year has drawn mixed views over fiscal scrutiny, independence and public health.
title_cn: 泰国卫生基金资金争议升温
summary_cn: 泰国政府计划终止泰国卫生基金（ThaiHealth）每年超40亿泰铢的烟酒税专款拨付，引发各界关于财政监管、机构独立性和公共卫生的多方观点。这关乎医疗公共服务的可持续性。
desc_original: The government's plan to end ThaiHealth's earmarked alcohol and tobacco tax funding of more than 4 billion baht a year has drawn mixed views over fiscal scrutiny, independence and public health.

title: Govt moves to protect meet
desc: The government has developed a business continuity plan to ensure the 2026 IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings run smoothly, even if heavy rainfall mars the global gathering, said Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.
title_cn: 政府制定应急预案确保IMF-世界银行年会顺利举行
summary_cn: 泰国政府已制定周密的业务连续性计划，确保2026年国际货币基金组织-世界银行年会顺利进行。财政部长艾克尼蒂·尼蒂坦帕帕斯表示，政府充分考虑到可能的恶劣天气影响，特别是暴雨风险，制定了应对措施，以保障这一重要的全球经济论坛圆满成功。
desc_original: The government has developed a business continuity plan to ensure the 2026 IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings run smoothly, even if heavy rainfall mars the global gathering, said Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

title: Nene to perform at IMF dinner
desc: Nene Royal, the 16-year-old Thai winner of America's Got Talent, will perform at a state dinner hosted by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul for 400 global leaders attending the IMF-World Bank meetings at Government House on Oct 14.
title_cn: 天才少女Nene Royal将亮相IMF晚宴献艺
summary_cn: 16岁的泰国歌手Nene Royal以「美国达人秀」冠军身份享誉全球，她将在10月14日出席泰国总理阿努廷·查尼瓦拉库为参加IMF-世界银行年会的400位全球政经领导人举办的盛大国宴，献上精彩表演，展现泰国文化魅力。
desc_original: Nene Royal, the 16-year-old Thai winner of America's Got Talent, will perform at a state dinner hosted by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul for 400 global leaders attending the IMF-World Bank meetings at Government House on Oct 14.

title: BJT MP challenges committee boss
desc: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Suphachai Jaismut on Wednesday challenged House committee chairman Rangsiman Rome's authority to place allegations against fellow BJT MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband on the committee's agenda.
title_cn: 泰爱党议员质疑委员会主席权限
summary_cn: 泰爱党议员苏帕柴·杰斯慕特于周三公开质疑众议院委员会主席让西曼·罗马的权限，反对其将针对同党议员苏查达·张塔恩萨普及其丈夫的控告事项列入委员会议程，这一举动引发党内政治纠纷和权力争议。
desc_original: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Suphachai Jaismut on Wednesday challenged House committee chairman Rangsiman Rome's authority to place allegations against fellow BJT MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband on the committee's agenda.

title: Chula launches new centre
desc: Chulalongkorn University's Faculty of Engineering has launched a Water Resilience Centre to help Thailand prepare for extreme flooding under a "Black Swan" scenario in which multiple threats strike simultaneously.
title_cn: 朱拉隆功大学启动水韧性研究中心应对极端洪灾
summary_cn: 享誉东南亚的朱拉隆功大学工程学院正式启动水韧性研究中心，聚焦帮助泰国应对「黑天鹅」突发事件下的极端洪涝灾害。该中心旨在通过科学研究和创新技术，预防和缓解多重自然威胁同时出现的复合灾害风险。
desc_original: Chulalongkorn University's Faculty of Engineering has launched a Water Resilience Centre to help Thailand prepare for extreme flooding under a "Black Swan" scenario in which multiple threats strike simultaneously.

title: 2 Myanmar women, 1 Chinese held over B200m scam
desc: Police have arrested a Chinese man and two Myanmar women over an alleged call-centre network accused of defrauding at least seven students of more than 200 million baht.
title_cn: 跨国诈骗团伙被控诈骗学生2亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国警方破获一起涉及跨国诈骗集团的大案，逮捕了一名中国籍男子和两名缅甸籍女性。这个犯罪团伙通过呼叫中心实施诈骗，已确认至少7名学生遭受欺诈，总损失金额超过2亿泰铢，案件性质严重。
desc_original: Police have arrested a Chinese man and two Myanmar women over an alleged call-centre network accused of defrauding at least seven students of more than 200 million baht.

title: Thailand weather today, 8 October: heavy rain in 8 provinces, Bangkok a few showers
desc: Thailand weather today, 8 October: heavy rain in 8 provinces, Bangkok a few showers Legacy Heavy rain is forecast in 8 provinces today, with the south seeing the worst of the weather. Chumphon, Nakhon Si Thammarat, Narathiwat, Songkhla, Surat Thani, Yala, Phang Nga and Ranong are named for heavy or very heavy rain. Bangkok faces isolated thundershowers with lows of 24-26°C and highs of 33-35°C. People in the south are warned of flash floods and overflows. The risk is greatest along waterways near foothills and lowlands. From 9 to 13 October, rain is expected to intensify across the east, the central region including Bangkok, and the south. A high-pressure system currently covers upper Thailand. Easterly winds dominate over the Gulf and the south. A monsoon trough moving in from China is set to shift the pattern later in the week. Bangkok Isolated thundershowers are expected across the capital today. Lows of 24-26°C and highs of 33-35°C are forecast. Northeasterly winds of 10 to 20km/h are expected. title: Thaksin appears in court to challenge asset seizure
desc: Former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra told a court on Wednesday that the seizure and freezing of his assets to recover a 17.6-billion-baht tax debt were unlawful, arguing that poor coordination between the Revenue Department and the Ministry of Finance had led to him being pursued twice for the same debt.
title_cn: 他信出庭抗辩资产冻结案

title: Foreign TikToker criticised over taped-phone stunt on Bangkok BTS
desc: Foreign TikToker criticised over taped-phone stunt on Bangkok BTS Legacy A foreign TikTok user has drawn criticism on Thai social media after posting a video that appeared to show him attaching his phone to a BTS Skytrain carriage with tape to record footage as the train departed. The creator, who Thai social media users believe is Russian, posted the video on TikTok and Instagram yesterday, October 6, with the caption, “Subway surface in Bangkok experience”. The footage appeared to show the man attaching his phone to the exterior surface of a BTS train using grey adhesive tape while the train was stopped at Surasak BTS Station. A security guard was seen approaching the phone and attempting to remove it. The phone appeared to remain attached as the train began moving. The video then showed the creator running along the platform as the train departed. He was unable to keep up once the train gained speed. Later footage showed views of ICONSIAM and the Chao Phraya River from the moving train. Photo via TikTok The video prompted mixed reactions from Thai social media users. title: Fighter jet tyre bursts on Ubon runway, diverts Bangkok flights
desc: Fighter jet tyre bursts on Ubon runway, diverts Bangkok flights Legacy An F-5 TH fighter jet suffered a tyre blowout while landing at Ubon Ratchathani Airport today, October 7, temporarily closing the runway and forcing some passenger flights from Bangkok to turn back . The Royal Thai Air Force said the aircraft, operated by Squadron 211 of Wing 21 in Ubon Ratchathani, developed the problem on the runway at around 11.30am. The incident affected incoming commercial flights while airport staff worked to move the disabled aircraft and clear the runway. Among the affected services were AirAsia flight FD3374 from Don Mueang to Ubon Ratchathani and Thai VietJet flight VZ220 from Suvarnabhumi to Ubon Ratchathani. Photo via ป้อนป้อนพาเที่ยว Both were among the flights unable to land while the runway was closed for safety reasons and had to return to Bangkok. The Air Force said the problem was caused by one of the fighter jet’s tyres bursting during landing. It added that this type of failure can occur with aircraft and may be caused by a wheel hitting an object or other foreign material on the runway during touchdown. Airport rescue personnel and other relevant teams immediately inspected

title: 27 provinces, Bangkok remain flooded as crisis continues
desc: 27 provinces, Bangkok remain flooded as crisis continues Legacy Flooding remains across 27 provinces and Bangkok , affecting more than 3.16 million people and leaving 52 dead as heavy rain and runoff from northern Thailand continue to worsen conditions across central and eastern regions. The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) said at 6am today, October 7, that floods were affecting 123 districts, 984 subdistricts and 7,215 villages, covering 1,154,875 households and 3,160,972 people. The affected provinces are Mae Hong Son, Chiang Mai, Lamphun, Nan, Phayao, Tak, Nakhon Sawan, Uthai Thani, Lop Buri, Sing Buri, Chai Nat, Suphan Buri, Kanchanaburi, Ang Thong, Saraburi, Ayutthaya, Samut Prakan, Pathum Thani, Nakhon Pathom, Ratchaburi, Samut Songkhram, Phetchaburi, Nakhon Nayok, Prachin Buri, Chachoengsao, Chon Buri and Rayong, along with Bangkok. Photo via JS100 Radio Prachin Buri recorded the highest death toll, with 19 people killed and 59,934 households affected across all seven districts. Water levels there were still rising. Samut Prakan reported nine deaths and 223,346 affected households, while Pathum Thani recorded two deaths and 246,818 affected households

title: 5 things to do in Bangkok this weekend (October 9 to 11)
desc: 5 things to do in Bangkok this weekend (October 9 to 11) Legacy Bangkok’s weekend begins with one of the city’s most recognisable annual traditions. Yaowarat is going vegetarian to mark the start of the kin jay festival, bringing food stalls, worship, and processions into Chinatown as the nine-day observance begins . Away from the crowds, there are more than a million books to dig through at Big Bad Wolf, an exhibition dedicated entirely to stationery, live snake demonstrations at one of Bangkok’s oldest scientific institutions, and a photography show looking at the city beyond its postcard image. Here are five things to do in Bangkok from October 9 to 11. title: Your health insurance may not give you the specialist you want
desc: Your health insurance may not give you the specialist you want Legacy At many private hospitals in Thailand, choosing a specialist is easier than working out what your outpatient insurance will pay for. The online appointment system gives patients two options: ask the hospital to recommend a doctor or choose the doctor yourself. Some hospitals also let patients search by speciality, language and preferred date, with instant booking available for some doctors. For an expat using Thailand’s private healthcare system, finding the right specialist is usually straightforward; the insurance side is less obvious. Being free to book a cardiologist, neurologist or orthopaedic specialist does not mean your policy will pay for that consultation in the way you expect. The answer can depend on whether the appointment counts as outpatient care, how the provider is paid and what happens if the first consultation leads to scans, procedures or hospital treatment. title: Around 2,000 pigs drown in Prachin Buri farm floods
desc: Around 2,000 pigs drown in Prachin Buri farm floods Legacy Around 2,000 pigs drowned after flash floods hit a large farm in Prachin Buri, prompting livestock officials to deploy more than 50 staff and heavy machinery to remove and bury the carcasses . Department of Livestock Development Director-General Chaiwat Yothakhol said on October 6 that the flooding affected a large pig farm in Mueang Prachin Buri district. Officials first moved surviving pigs out of the flooded area before beginning the carcass removal operation . High water levels have made access to the farm difficult. An initial 50 carcasses were transported for burial, with officials expecting to bury around 1,400 pigs on October 6. If no storms disrupted the operation, they expected to complete the remaining work on October 7. Photo via Nation TV More than 50 officials from the Prachin Buri Provincial Livestock Office, the Division of Veterinary Inspection and Quarantine and animal quarantine units in eastern Thailand have been deployed. The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation is also supporting the operation with five six-wheel trucks, a loader, a backhoe to dig burial pits and a flat-bottomed boat. Chaiw

title: Phuket launches Licence Lab to help small stays get licensed
desc: Phuket launches Licence Lab to help small stays get licensed Legacy Phuket has launched the “ Phuket Licence Lab ” to help small and medium-sized accommodation businesses overcome building and regulatory problems that have prevented many from obtaining the licences needed to operate legally . Five organisations from the professional, academic and tourism sectors signed a memorandum of understanding for the project on October 5 at Phuket City Development Company, or PKCD, in Mueang Phuket district. The project was developed because many small and medium-sized accommodation businesses in Phuket remain unable to obtain licences, often because their buildings were constructed before certain regulations came into force. Common obstacles include fire exits, fire protection systems, building setbacks and open-space requirements, urban planning rules, wastewater treatment systems and land ownership documents. These problems can affect both guest safety and the ability of operators to bring their businesses into compliance. desc_original: “อนุทิน” ถึงนิวยอร์ก เตรียมร่วมประชุมสมัชชาสหประชาชาติ สมัยสามัญ ครั้งที่ 81 พร้อมจัดไทยแลนด์โรดโชว์ ดึงลงทุน โพสต์เพลงดังระดับโลก สื่อความหมาย “ถ้าสำเร็จที่นี่ ก็สำเร็จได้ทุกที่ในโลก”

title_cn: 盗版内容泛滥跨平台流通 当局警示金钱与隐私风险
summary_cn: 泰国知识产权部门加强打击盗版电影和电视剧，呼吁公众远离非法平台。盗版内容跨平台扩散容易导致用户金钱损失和个人数据泄露。相关法律规定供应盗版内容者需承担法律责任。

title: Somchart to get final summons
desc: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will issue a final summons on Monday to Somchart Techathavorncharoen, a Phuket MP from the People's Party, to testify as a witness in an inquiry into property ownership and the alleged use of Thai nominees for foreign nationals, the Justice Ministry said.
title_cn: 普吉岛议员索姆察获最终传唤令
summary_cn: 特别调查部门将于周一向普吉岛人民党议员索姆察·德差塔沃查查(Somchart Techathavorncharoen)发出最终传唤令，要求其就财产所有权以及涉嫌利用泰籍代理人为外国人谋利等事项作证。这是该案调查的关键进展。
desc_original: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will issue a final summons on Monday to Somchart Techathavorncharoen, a Phuket MP from the People's Party, to testify as a witness in an inquiry into property ownership and the alleged use of Thai nominees for foreign nationals, the Justice Ministry said.

summary_cn: 奥伊西（Oishi）饮料公司推出新口味绿茶「草莓之吻」，定价10泰铢，目标消费人群为年轻人和上班族。公司在泰国北部和东北地区展开密集营销，包括当地媒体宣传、体验活动和抽奖促销，致力于扩大地方市场的消费者基础。

title: Cabinet mulls extending co-pay scheme
desc: The cabinet is set to consider extending the "Thai Chuay Thai Plus" co-payment scheme on Tuesday. Local wholesalers and retailers are backing the extension.
title_cn: 泰国内阁拟延长「泰国助泰」共付计划
summary_cn: 泰国内阁定于周二审议是否延长「泰国助泰升级版」（Thai Chuay Thai Plus）共付计划。该计划通过政府补贴帮助消费者分摊购物成本，已获得当地批发商和零售商的广泛支持。此举旨在进一步刺激国内消费，缓解消费者购物压力。
desc_original: The cabinet is set to consider extending the "Thai Chuay Thai Plus" co-payment scheme on Tuesday. Local wholesalers and retailers are backing the extension.

title: เอ็มบีเค ชู “Cave Fantasy” ดึงครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersiveจัดแพ็กเกจพิเศษ 1,399 บาท
desc: เอ็ม บี เค เซ็นเตอร์ ชวนครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersive ที่ Cave Fantasy จัด Family Package 1,399 บาท จากปกติ 1,647 บาท พร้อม Fantasy Space และ Fight Theater 4 มิติ ตลอดเดือน ก.ย.
title_cn: MBK中心推「洞穴幻想」3D沉浸式体验 家庭套票1399泰铢
summary_cn: MBK购物中心（MBK Center）推出「洞穴幻想」3D沉浸式体验馆，吸引家庭游客体验虚拟现实世界。家庭套票定价1399泰铢（较原价1647泰铢的折扣优惠），套票包含幻想空间和四维搏击影院等多个互动项目。该优惠活动贯穿整个九月，为曼谷家庭游客提供寓教于乐的室内娱乐新选择。
desc_original: เอ็ม บี เค เซ็นเตอร์ ชวนครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersive ที่ Cave Fantasy จัด Family Package 1,399 บาท จากปกติ 1,647 บาท พร้อม Fantasy Space และ Fight Theater 4 มิติ ตลอดเดือน ก.ย.

title: Postal law set for enactment by year-end
desc: The new postal law is expected to be enacted by the end of this year to address regulatory gaps and distortions in the rapidly expanding delivery and logistics market, according to Thailand Post president Dhanant Subhadrabandhu.
title_cn: 泰国新邮政法有望年底前颁布
summary_cn: 泰国邮政公司（Thailand Post）总裁达南特（Dhanant Subhadrabandhu）日前宣布，新邮政法拟在年底前正式颁布实施。该法规旨在填补现有监管空白，并纠正快速扩张的物流配送市场中的市场扭曲现象。完善的法律框架将进一步规范泰国邮政与快递行业的健康发展。
desc_original: The new postal law is expected to be enacted by the end of this year to address regulatory gaps and distortions in the rapidly expanding delivery and logistics market, according to Thailand Post president Dhanant Subhadrabandhu.

title: Larger data centres set to shift beyond Bangkok
desc: Bangkok remains Thailand's main data centre hub, but infrastructure constraints and tighter regulatory requirements could push larger projects outside the capital, according to Kasikorn Research Center.
title_cn: 大型数据中心逐步转向曼谷以外地区
summary_cn: 根据卡西空研究中心（Kasikorn Research Center）的分析，虽然曼谷目前仍为泰国主要数据中心枢纽，但基础设施约束和日益严格的监管要求可能促使大型数据中心项目逐步迁出首都。这一趋势将推动泰国数据中心产业的地域均衡分布，为地方经济发展创造新机遇。
desc_original: Bangkok remains Thailand's main data centre hub, but infrastructure constraints and tighter regulatory requirements could push larger projects outside the capital, according to Kasikorn Research Center.

title: Households face rising health costs
desc: Households are likely to bear a larger share of healthcare costs in the future, as the government will have less capacity to shoulder the burden, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).
title_cn: 家庭医疗成本面临上升压力
summary_cn: 根据泰国财务集团 Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group（KKP）的分析，随着政府财政压力增大，家庭未来将需要承担更多的医疗成本。该机构指出，政府公共医疗预算面临严峻压力，难以继续提供现有水平的补助。这意味着医疗成本增加将直接影响泰国家庭特别是中低收入群体的生活开支。
desc_original: Households are likely to bear a larger share of healthcare costs in the future, as the government will have less capacity to shoulder the burden, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).

title: Saudi attack dents Mideast market
desc: The recent attack near Riyadh Airport could further hamper Saudi Arabia and the Middle East market, which have not fully recovered from the Gulf conflict that erupted earlier this year, according to the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).
title_cn: 沙特遇袭事件打击中东旅游市场
summary_cn: 泰国旅游代理商协会（Atta）表示，利雅得（Riyadh）机场附近的遇袭事件将进一步打击沙特阿拉伯和中东市场的恢复前景。该地区目前尚未从今年早些时候爆发的海湾冲突中完全恢复，新的安全威胁将加重市场不确定性。对于依赖中东市场的泰国旅游业而言，这一事件的负面影响不容忽视。
desc_original: The recent attack near Riyadh Airport could further hamper Saudi Arabia and the Middle East market, which have not fully recovered from the Gulf conflict that erupted earlier this year, according to the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).

title: Policymakers urged to back alcohol-to-jet technology
desc: Business leaders and energy industry representatives are calling on policymakers to accelerate support for alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) technology, saying it could help reduce its reliance on imported crude oil while creating new demand for domestic agricultural products.
title_cn: 推动酒精制喷气燃料技术成为战略焦点
summary_cn: 泰国商业领袖和能源行业代表呼吁政策制定者加快推进酒精制喷气燃料（Alcohol-to-Jet, ATJ）技术的发展。这一新技术不仅有助于减少泰国对进口原油的依赖、降低能源成本，还能为国内农产品创造新的市场需求，实现能源和农业的协同发展。该举措对于泰国实现经济可持续转型具有重要的战略意义。
desc_original: Business leaders and energy industry representatives are calling on policymakers to accelerate support for alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) technology, saying it could help reduce its reliance on imported crude oil while creating new demand for domestic agricultural products.

title: AirAsia worries markets despite reassurances
desc: Analysts are expressing concern over Asia Aviation (AAV), saying higher jet fuel prices and financial strains faced by its Malaysian parent, AirAsia, could eventually affect the SET-listed low-cost carrier's operations.
title_cn: 亚洲航空股价面临多重压力
summary_cn: 市场分析人士对泰国上市航空公司亚洲航空（Asia Aviation, AAV）的前景表示担忧。国际航空燃油价格高企，加上其马来西亚母公司亚洲航空集团（AirAsia）面临的财务困难，这些负面因素最终可能波及泰国上市子公司的日常运营和财务表现。在全球航空业竞争激烈的环境中，这一系列压力值得投资者和市场关注。
desc_original: Analysts are expressing concern over Asia Aviation (AAV), saying higher jet fuel prices and financial strains faced by its Malaysian parent, AirAsia, could eventually affect the SET-listed low-cost carrier's operations.

title: Business groups urged to help bolster investment
desc: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged business groups to help drive investment in seven strategic industries as Thailand seeks to become a high-income economy within the next four years.
title_cn: 财政部长敦促商界投资七大战略产业
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长 Ekniti Nitithanprapas 呼吁商业集团积极参与投资七个战略产业，以推动泰国经济向高收入国家行列迈进，目标在未来四年内完成。这七个战略产业是泰国经济增长和产业升级的关键领域。政府通过激励商业投资，旨在实现更快速和更可持续的经济发展，反映了泰国在经济政策上的新方向。
desc_original: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged business groups to help drive investment in seven strategic industries as Thailand seeks to become a high-income economy within the next four years.

title: Stock exchange vows to continue its package of major reforms
desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) is pursuing a sweeping package of statutory and structural reforms to strengthen corporate governance, attract high-growth new economy listings and make Thai companies more attractive to investors, says SET chairman Kitipong Urapeepatanapong.
title_cn: 泰国证券交易所承诺继续推进重大改革方案
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易所(SET)主席基提蓬·乌拉佩帕塔那蓬表示，交易所正在推进包括法定和结构性改革在内的全面改革计划，旨在加强公司治理、吸引高增长新经济上市公司，并提升泰国企业在国际投资者中的吸引力。这一系列改革措施体现了交易所推动泰国资本市场健康发展的决心。
desc_original: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) is pursuing a sweeping package of statutory and structural reforms to strengthen corporate governance, attract high-growth new economy listings and make Thai companies more attractive to investors, says SET chairman Kitipong Urapeepatanapong.

title: Fuel tax cut mulled amid energy crisis
desc: The government is considering a reduction in the excise tax on fuel to ease the cost-of-living burden on the public caused by the energy crisis.
title_cn: 政府考虑削减燃油税应对能源危机
summary_cn: 在能源危机导致生活成本上升的背景下，泰国政府正在考虑降低燃油消费税，以缓解民众和企业的经济负担。燃油税削减将直接降低运输、物流成本，有助于减轻普通家庭的生活压力。这一政策调整是政府应对能源危机、稳定物价的重要举措。
desc_original: The government is considering a reduction in the excise tax on fuel to ease the cost-of-living burden on the public caused by the energy crisis.

title: PP to submit Senate vote collusion 'evidence'
desc: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut said on Monday the party would submit evidence to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) by Friday over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.
title_cn: 人民党向反腐委提交参议院选举串通「证据」
summary_cn: 人民党(PP)领导人纳塔蓬·瑞英帕尼亚武特周一宣布，该党将在本周五前向国家反腐委员会(NACC)提交证据，控告2024年参议院选举中存在串通舞弊行为。这起案件涉及泰国选举制度的公正性和民主进程，引起社会各界高度关注，将对泰国政治生态产生重要影响。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut said on Monday the party would submit evidence to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) by Friday over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

title: DSI to forward Forex-3D scam dossier to prosecutors
desc: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is expected to forward its completed case file in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud investigation to public prosecutors this week.
title_cn: 特别调查局将Forex-3D诈骗案转交检控机构
summary_cn: 泰国特别调查局(DSI)预计本周将完成Forex-3D投资诈骗案的调查，并向公诉机构提交完整案卷。该案是近年来备受瞩目的重大诈骗案件，涉及大规模非法集资和投资欺诈，受害者众多。案卷提交后，公诉机构将决定是否正式起诉相关嫌疑人。
desc_original: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is expected to forward its completed case file in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud investigation to public prosecutors this week.

title: Senators query EC after names appear in probe files
desc: A group of senators calling themselves New Breed senators have questioned the Election Commission (EC) over complaints against them after finding their names in separate investigation files.
title_cn: 参议员名单现身调查文件 质询选委会
summary_cn: 自称「新一代参议员」的一群参议员在发现自己的名字出现在独立调查文件中后，向选举委员会(EC)提出质询。这些参议员要求委员会解释针对他们的投诉内容并说明调查进展，反映了围绕参议院合规性和选举程序的持续政治争议，体现了参议院内部的权力制衡。
desc_original: A group of senators calling themselves New Breed senators have questioned the Election Commission (EC) over complaints against them after finding their names in separate investigation files.

title: Air hostess heroin case advances
desc: The Office of the Attorney-General (OAG) has ordered the indictment of four suspects allegedly linked to a transnational drug trafficking network involving Thai Airways flight attendant Meena Kondo in a heroin smuggling case.
title_cn: 泰航空姐毒品案进展，律政署下令起诉四名嫌疑人
summary_cn: 泰国律政署下令起诉四名嫌疑人，他们涉嫌参与一个跨国毒品贩运网络。案件涉及泰国航空公司空姐Meena Kondo走私海洛因。此案反映了国际毒品走私网络的活跃，可能对机场安全和国际旅客造成影响。
desc_original: The Office of the Attorney-General (OAG) has ordered the indictment of four suspects allegedly linked to a transnational drug trafficking network involving Thai Airways flight attendant Meena Kondo in a heroin smuggling case.

title: PM eyes stronger Japan ties
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday urged Thailand and Japan to move from producing goods for one another to producing them together, saying closer supply-chain ties would help sustain Japanese investment as the automotive industry shifts towards electric vehicles.
title_cn: 泰国总理促深化泰日经济合作，共同应对电动车转型
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷周一呼吁泰日两国从各自生产转向联合制造，认为深化供应链合作能维持日本在电动汽车时代的投资。这一举措旨在强化两国经贸关系，应对全球汽车产业转型。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday urged Thailand and Japan to move from producing goods for one another to producing them together, saying closer supply-chain ties would help sustain Japanese investment as the automotive industry shifts towards electric vehicles.

title: Seniors urged to use traditional Chinese medicine  to slow cognitive decline
desc: Older people are being encouraged to adopt four daily practices based on traditional Chinese medicine to help maintain brain health and slow cognitive decline.
title_cn: 老年人宜采用中医疗法缓解认知功能衰退
summary_cn: 卫生部门鼓励老年人采用四项基于中医理论的日常保健方法，以维持脑部健康、缓减认知衰退。这些传统养生实践被认为有助于改善老年人的脑健康。
desc_original: Older people are being encouraged to adopt four daily practices based on traditional Chinese medicine to help maintain brain health and slow cognitive decline.

title: Govt racing to conclude US tariff negotiations
desc: Thailand is seeking to conclude trade negotiations with the United States before Washington announces the results of investigations into Thai trade practices that could lead to additional tariffs, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.
title_cn: 泰国加紧美国关税谈判，力争在调查公布前达成协议
summary_cn: 泰国商业副总理兼商务部长素帕杰表示，泰国正力争在美国宣布对泰国贸易行为调查结果前达成贸易协议，以避免面临额外关税。这反映了美泰贸易谈判的紧迫性和复杂性。
desc_original: Thailand is seeking to conclude trade negotiations with the United States before Washington announces the results of investigations into Thai trade practices that could lead to additional tariffs, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.

title: Anutin says cabinet has no ties to grey businesses
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul insisted on Monday that no member of his cabinet has ties to grey or illicit businesses and that his government has no reason to compromise with anyone involved in illegal activities.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷否认内阁与灰色产业有关联
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷周一强调，其内阁成员与灰色或非法业务没有任何关联，政府无需与涉及非法活动的人士妥协。此言论旨在回应对政府廉洁性的质疑。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul insisted on Monday that no member of his cabinet has ties to grey or illicit businesses and that his government has no reason to compromise with anyone involved in illegal activities.

title: Farmers oppose seed changes
desc: Farmer groups and their civil society allies will gather at the Agriculture Ministry on Wednesday to oppose draft legal changes that would align Thailand with an international convention granting plant breeders stronger intellectual property rights over new seed varieties.
title_cn: 农民反对种子改革法案
summary_cn: 泰国农民团体及民间组织将于周三在农业部集会，反对政府拟议的法律改革草案。该草案旨在使泰国与国际公约接轨，强化植物育种者对新品种种子的知识产权保护。农民担忧此举将提高种子采购成本，限制农民的育种自主权。
desc_original: Farmer groups and their civil society allies will gather at the Agriculture Ministry on Wednesday to oppose draft legal changes that would align Thailand with an international convention granting plant breeders stronger intellectual property rights over new seed varieties.

title: Thailand tourist arrivals top 22m as Malaysia, Japan surge
desc: Thailand tourist arrivals top 22m as Malaysia, Japan surge Legacy Thailand tourist arrivals have passed 22.18 million so far this year, while the latest weekly figures improved as holiday travel from Malaysia and Japan gave short-haul markets a lift ahead of the October high season. Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said yesterday, September 21, that Thailand welcomed 22,183,678 foreign visitors between January 1 and September 19. The total was still 3.67% lower than during the same period last yea r, while foreign tourism revenue reached 1.082821 trillion baht. China remained Thailand’s largest source market with 3,728,585 visitors, followed by Malaysia with 2,831,654 and India with 1,640,441. Russia ranked fourth with 1,230,256 arrivals, while South Korea contributed 811,246. The latest week showed a stronger picture as Thailand recorded 464,200 foreign arrivals from September 13 to 19, an increase of 25,131 visitors, or 5.72%, from the previous week. That worked out to an average of 66,314 arrivals per day. Short-haul markets accounted for 324,816 visitors, rising 8.59% week on week, while long-haul arrivals slipped 0.41% to 139,384. title: Thai King’s son wants to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery
desc: Thai King’s son wants to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery Legacy Dr Chakriwat “Than Aong” Vivacharawongse, a son of Thailand’s King Maha Vajiralongkorn, has spoken publicly about his wish to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery. In a video posted overnight, Dr Chakriwat said he has two large brain tumours requiring surgery. He wants to receive treatment in Thailand because he believes Thai doctors have the necessary expertise. He said he does not have enough money to undergo the operation in Malaysia or the United States. He also fears he could die if he does not receive proper treatment in time. “I want to return to Thailand for treatment because Thai doctors are highly capable,” he said in the video, according to his account of the situation. The appeal provides new details about the medical emergency he disclosed on September 18. At the time, the 43-year-old physician said his health was in a “truly terrible condition” and that several neurologists had warned he could become bedridden or lose his life if treatment were delayed. title: Doping shock rocks Thailand camp at Asian Games
desc: Badminton player Pitchamon Opatniputh has emerged as the first known doping case at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, after the 19-year-old rising star returned a positive test that has rocked Thailand's campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.
title_cn: 亚运会兴奋剂丑闻 泰国羽毛球新星检测阳性
summary_cn: 在日本爱知-名古屋举办的第20届亚运会上，19岁泰国羽毛球新星皮查蒙·奥帕特尼普塔（Pitchamon Opatniputh）药检呈阳性，成为本届亚运会首例兴奋剂违规案例，对泰国体育代表团造成重大打击。
desc_original: Badminton player Pitchamon Opatniputh has emerged as the first known doping case at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, after the 19-year-old rising star returned a positive test that has rocked Thailand's campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.

title: City Hall working on new master drainage plan for Bangkok
desc: Bangkok's City Hall has partnered with a Japanese government agency in designing a long-term urban drainage master plan to prepare the capital for heavier rainfall, with a target of coping with 100 millimetres of rain per hour.
title_cn: 曼谷市政厅推进排水系统总体规划 应对极端降雨
summary_cn: 曼谷市政厅与日本政府机构合作制定长期城市排水总体规划，为应对日益加剧的极端降雨做准备。规划目标是提高城市排水能力至每小时100毫米降雨量。这是曼谷适应气候变化、提升城市韧性的重要基础设施投资。
desc_original: Bangkok's City Hall has partnered with a Japanese government agency in designing a long-term urban drainage master plan to prepare the capital for heavier rainfall, with a target of coping with 100 millimetres of rain per hour.

title: Chon Buri flags 14,264 firms with foreign shareholders for nominee checks
desc: Chon Buri flags 14,264 firms with foreign shareholders for nominee checks Legacy Seventy companies were picked for detailed checks and 39 were rated high risk. Sixteen gave no explanation, and all the cases are now with the Department of Special Investigation. Chon Buri has identified 14,264 companies with foreign shareholders or co-investors as needing risk monitoring. Officials say the review is looking for firms that use Thai nominees or hold land illegally. The figures were presented to a House foreign affairs committee at Pattaya City Hall on Friday, September 18. Officials stressed that foreign shareholding was not in itself illegal. The provincial commerce chief, Hathairat Keerival, said 70 companies were selected for detailed inspection in the first phase. Fifty-four submitted explanations and 16 did not. A risk assessment put 39 of the 70 in the high-risk group and 31 in the low-risk group. All the cases are now under investigation by the DSI, Hathairat said. In Banglamung district alone, 350 companies with foreign ownership hold land. That figure came from Chaiporn Prasertsiri of the Banglamung branch of the Chon Buri Land Office. title: 3 Thai women held at Sri Lanka airport with nearly 8kg of cannabis
desc: 3 Thai women held at Sri Lanka airport with nearly 8kg of cannabis Legacy Three Thai women were arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport in Katunayake, Sri Lanka , after almost eight kilogrammes of cannabis were found hidden in their luggage. The Airport Police Narcotics Bureau announced the arrests on Sunday, September 20. According to Sri Lankan authorities, the three women had travelled from Bangkok on the same Thai Airways flight, TG307, which landed at about 12.50am. Police reportedly found the drugs hidden inside their luggage, with the packages disguised as nutritional supplements, collagen products and bars of soap. The arrests were made during two separate operations. In the first operation, a 38 year old Thai woman was allegedly found carrying 3.22 kilogrammes of cannabis and 1.85 kilogrammes of hashish. Photo by Nednapa via Getty Images In the second operation, a 31 year old Thai woman was allegedly found with 1.99 kilogrammes of Kush and 620 grammes of hashish. Another Thai woman, aged 36, who travelled on the same flight, was also arrested on suspicion of assisting with cannabis trafficking. title: Thailand weighs minimum delivery rider pay, platform pushes back
desc: Thailand weighs minimum delivery rider pay, platform pushes back Legacy Thailand is moving towards a minimum compensation framework for app-based delivery riders , with officials looking beyond an ongoing dispute involving Lalamove to develop rules that could eventually apply more broadly across digital platforms. Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob said the ministry is collecting information on rider costs and payment rates to develop a minimum-rate formula. Rather than relying only on data from Lalamove and its riders, officials plan to expand the study to other platforms and groups of workers before deciding what an appropriate benchmark should look like. The work could eventually feed into legislation covering platform workers, a group that currently does not have a specific law directly regulating compensation in this area.
